title: My First Flight
paragraphs: Last summer, Mia traveled [[abroad|J-0008]] for the first time. She was seventeen, and her parents [[allowed|J-0040]] her to visit her aunt in another country with her older cousin, Leo. On the day of the trip, her [[alarm|J-0035]] went off at four in the morning, but she was [[already|J-0045]] up. She felt happy and a little nervous at the same time.

At the [[airport|J-0034]], the two of them checked in at the [[airline|J-0032]] counter and walked [[along|J-0043]] a long hall to the gate. Leo gave Mia some [[advice|J-0021]]: "Keep your passport in your bag and stay close to me." Mia [[agreed|J-0029]]. On the [[airplane|J-0033]], she looked out the window at the clouds and the blue sky. "I am really flying," she said [[aloud|J-0044]].

During the trip, Mia and Leo took many photos together. After she came home, Mia put them in an [[album|J-0036]]. Her parents looked at the pictures and laughed. "You and Leo look [[alike|J-0037]] in this one!" Mia smiled. The trip was short, but it made her feel more like an [[adult|J-0020]].
zh: 去年夏天，Mia 第一次出國旅行。她當時十七歲，爸媽允許她和表哥 Leo 一起去另一個國家看阿姨。出發那天，她的鬧鐘在清晨四點響起，但她早就醒了。她同時覺得很開心，又有一點緊張。
到了機場，兩人在航空公司櫃檯辦好報到手續，沿著一條長長的走廊走到登機門。Leo 給了 Mia 一些建議：「護照放在包包裡，跟緊我。」Mia 同意了。在飛機上，她望向窗外的雲和藍天，大聲說：「我真的在飛耶！」
旅途中，Mia 和 Leo 一起拍了很多照片。回家以後，Mia 把照片放進相簿。爸媽看著照片笑了：「這張裡你和 Leo 長得好像！」Mia 笑了笑。這趟旅行雖然很短，卻讓她覺得自己更像個大人了。

questions.stem: What happened when Mia's alarm went off?
options: She was late for the airplane.
questions.explain: 第一段說鬧鐘四點響時她早就起來了，故選 (C)。(A) 說她還在睡，和 already up 相反。
questions.evidence: On the day of the trip, her alarm went off at four in the morning, but she was already up.

questions.stem: The word "aloud" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to ______.
options: in a way that others can hear
questions.explain: aloud 是「出聲地、大聲地」，也就是別人聽得到，故選 (A)。(C) 是在心裡想，沒有說出來，意思相反。
questions.evidence: "I am really flying," she said aloud.

questions.stem: In paragraph 3, what does "this one" refer to?
questions.explain: 爸媽正在看照片，說「這張」裡兩人長得很像，this one 指的是一張照片，故選 (D)。(B) 相簿是整本，不會說人在相簿裡長得像。
questions.evidence: Her parents looked at the pictures and laughed.

questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?
options: How to buy cheap airplane tickets
Mia's first trip abroad and how it made her feel
Why Mia's parents like taking photos
A problem Mia had at the airport
questions.explain: 全文從出發、搭機到回家整理相簿，寫 Mia 第一次出國的經過與感受，故選 (B)。(D) 文中在機場一切順利，沒有遇到問題。
questions.evidence: The trip was short, but it made her feel more like an adult.

vocab.stem: My teacher gave me some good ______ about how to study for the test.
vocab.explain: 老師給了關於如何準備考試的好「建議」，故選 advice。accident（意外）、album（相簿）、airport（機場）都不合句意。

vocab.stem: Our school does not ______ students to use cellphones in class.
vocab.explain: allow sb. to V 表示「允許某人做某事」，學校不允許上課用手機，故選 allow。agree 後面不能直接接人再接 to V。

title: An Afternoon with Baby Nina
paragraphs: One Saturday in [[autumn|J-0089]], my [[aunt|J-0088]] called me. She had to work, and her usual [[baby sitter|J-0093]] was not [[available|J-0090]]. "Can you take care of Nina this afternoon?" she asked. Nina is her one-year-old [[baby|J-0092]]. I said yes, but I was nervous. It was my first time [[alone|J-0042]] with a baby.

When I [[arrived|J-0079]] at her [[apartment|J-0068]], Nina was crying in her bed. I held her in my [[arms|J-0075]] and walked around the room. Then I sat down in a big [[armchair|J-0076]] and sang some songs to her. Slowly, she stopped crying. Twenty minutes later, she was [[asleep|J-0084]].

While Nina slept, I [[baked|J-0100]] some cookies in the kitchen. When my aunt came home, she looked tired, but a big smile [[appeared|J-0069]] on her face. "I really [[appreciate|J-0071]] your help," she said. By then, I was [[almost|J-0041]] as tired as she was. Taking care of a baby is hard work, but I felt proud.
zh: 秋天的某個星期六，阿姨打電話給我。她得去上班，平常的保母又沒空。「你今天下午可以幫忙照顧 Nina 嗎？」她問。Nina 是她一歲大的寶寶。我答應了，但心裡很緊張。這是我第一次一個人照顧嬰兒。
我到了阿姨的公寓時，Nina 正在床上哭。我把她抱在懷裡，在房間裡走來走去。接著我坐進一張大扶手椅，唱了幾首歌給她聽。慢慢地，她不哭了。二十分鐘後，她就睡著了。
Nina 睡覺時，我在廚房烤了一些餅乾。阿姨回到家時看起來很累，但臉上露出了大大的笑容。「真的很感謝你的幫忙。」她說。那時，我幾乎跟她一樣累了。照顧寶寶是件辛苦的工作，但我為自己感到驕傲。

questions.stem: Why did the aunt call the writer?
options: She wanted the writer to bake cookies for a party.
She needed someone to take care of her baby.
She wanted to visit the writer's apartment.
She was sick and needed to see a doctor.
questions.explain: 第一段說阿姨要上班、保母沒空，所以請作者照顧寶寶，故選 (B)。(A) 烤餅乾是作者後來自己做的，不是阿姨打電話的原因。
questions.evidence: She had to work, and her usual baby sitter was not available.

questions.stem: The word "available" in paragraph 1 is closest in meaning to ______.
questions.explain: available 指人「有空的、可以來的」，保母沒空所以阿姨才找作者，故選 (A)。(B) kind 是「親切的」，和有沒有空無關。
questions.evidence: She had to work, and her usual baby sitter was not available.

questions.stem: How did the aunt most likely feel when she came home?
options: Angry, because the baby was crying
Bored, because there was nothing to do
Worried, because the apartment was dirty
Thankful, because the writer helped her
questions.explain: 阿姨回家露出笑容，還說 I really appreciate your help，可見她很感激，故選 (D)。(A) 寶寶當時已經睡著，並沒有在哭。
questions.evidence: "I really appreciate your help," she said.

questions.stem: What is the best title for the passage?
questions.explain: 全文寫作者第一次獨自照顧寶寶，雖然很累卻為自己驕傲，故選 (C)。(A) 烤餅乾只是其中一個小細節。
questions.evidence: Taking care of a baby is hard work, but I felt proud.

vocab.stem: The bus finally ______ at the station after a two-hour trip.
vocab.explain: 公車經過兩小時車程終於「抵達」車站，arrive at 最通順，故選 arrived。answered（回答）、argued（爭吵）、asked（問）都不合句意。

vocab.stem: Ken was so tired that he fell ______ on the sofa while watching TV.
vocab.explain: fall asleep 是「睡著」，Ken 太累在沙發上睡著了，故選 asleep。fall away（脫落、減少）不合句意；fall afraid、fall alive 都不是正確搭配。

title: A Class Barbecue by the Sea
paragraphs: Last Saturday, our class went to a [[beach|J-0120]] in Hualien for a [[barbecue|J-0108]]. We [[arrived|J-0079]] at ten in the morning. The sea was blue, and the sky was clear. "What [[beautiful|J-0125]] weather!" Amy said. Everyone helped. Some students carried the food, and others put [[beef|J-0132]], corn, and green [[beans|J-0121]] on the fire.

I am a [[beginner|J-0136]] at cooking, so I was nervous. In the [[beginning|J-0137]], I burned two pieces of meat. Then Ben stood [[beside|J-0146]] me and showed me some [[basic|J-0113]] rules. "Turn the meat often, and be patient," he said. Soon my food tasted great. I could not [[believe|J-0140]] it!

After lunch, we played with a [[ball|J-0103]] on the sand. Later, I sat on a [[bench|J-0145]] and watched the waves. A bee flew around our food, but nobody was [[afraid|J-0022]]. Before we left, we picked up all our trash because the beach [[belongs|J-0142]] to everyone. It was a perfect day by the sea.
zh: 上星期六，我們班到花蓮的海灘烤肉。我們早上十點抵達。海很藍，天空很晴朗。「天氣真好！」Amy 說。大家都來幫忙，有些同學搬食物，有些把牛肉、玉米和四季豆放到火上烤。
我是烹飪新手，所以很緊張。一開始，我烤焦了兩塊肉。後來 Ben 站在我旁邊，教我一些基本原則。「肉要常翻面，而且要有耐心。」他說。很快地，我烤的東西變得很好吃。我簡直不敢相信！
午餐後，我們在沙灘上玩球。後來，我坐在長椅上看海浪。有一隻蜜蜂在我們的食物旁飛來飛去，但沒有人害怕。離開前，我們把垃圾全部撿乾淨，因為海灘屬於每一個人。那是在海邊度過的完美一天。

questions.stem: Who helped the writer cook?
questions.explain: 第二段說 Ben 站在作者旁邊，教他基本原則，故選 (C)。(A) Amy 只有在第一段稱讚天氣，沒有教作者烤肉。
questions.evidence: Then Ben stood beside me and showed me some basic rules.

questions.stem: The word "beginner" in paragraph 2 means a person who ______.
options: is just starting to learn something
questions.explain: beginner 是「初學者、新手」，作者剛開始學做菜，所以會烤焦肉，故選 (A)。(C) 從不犯錯與作者烤焦兩塊肉的事實相反。
questions.evidence: I am a beginner at cooking, so I was nervous.

questions.stem: Why did the students pick up their trash?
options: Their teacher wanted to check their work.
They wanted to keep the beach clean for other people.
The bee was flying around their trash.
They wanted to take the trash home to use again.
questions.explain: 文中說他們撿垃圾是因為海灘屬於每個人，可推知他們想為別人保持海灘乾淨，故選 (B)。(C) 蜜蜂是繞著食物飛，不是撿垃圾的原因。
questions.evidence: Before we left, we picked up all our trash because the beach belongs to everyone.

questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?
options: How to cook beef at home
A trip to buy food in Hualien
A fun day of cooking and playing at the beach
questions.explain: 全文寫全班到海邊烤肉、玩球、撿垃圾的一天，故選 (D)。(A) 文中是在海邊烤肉，不是在家做菜。
questions.evidence: It was a perfect day by the sea.

vocab.stem: This bag doesn't ______ to me. It's Lisa's.
vocab.explain: belong to 表示「屬於」，這個包包不是我的，是 Lisa 的，故選 belong。believe（相信）、begin（開始）、behave（表現）都不能接 to me 表示所有權。

vocab.stem: Before you learn hard songs on the guitar, you should practice some ______ skills first.
vocab.explain: 學難的曲子之前，應該先練「基本的」技巧，故選 basic。afraid、asleep 不能放在名詞前修飾 skills，beautiful 也不合句意。

title: A Birthday Plan for Leo
paragraphs: My little [[brother|J-0192]], Leo, has his [[birthday|J-0154]] next Sunday. He was [[born|J-0173]] 15 years [[ago|J-0028]]. Last year, we gave him a book, but he said it was [[boring|J-0172]] and never read it. This year, my sister and I want to do something different for him.

First, we plan to make him a special [[breakfast|J-0188]]. My sister will [[bake|J-0100]] some [[bread|J-0186]] and [[boil|J-0167]] a few eggs. I will [[build|J-0196]] a small birthday sign from an old box and paint his name on it. We also want to [[borrow|J-0174]] a camera from our neighbor, so we can take many photos.

Leo loves [[birds|J-0153]], so after breakfast we will take him to the park by the river. There is an old [[bridge|J-0189]] there, and many birds sit on the [[branches|J-0184]] of the tall trees. We will bring a [[blanket|J-0158]] and sit on the grass together. I [[believe|J-0140]] this will be his best birthday ever.
zh: 下星期天是我弟弟 Leo 的生日。他是十五年前出生的。去年我們送他一本書，但他說很無聊，從來沒讀過。今年，我和姊姊想為他做點不一樣的事。
首先，我們打算幫他做一頓特別的早餐。姊姊會烤一些麵包、煮幾顆蛋。我會用舊箱子做一個小小的生日牌子，在上面畫上他的名字。我們也想跟鄰居借一台相機，這樣就能拍很多照片。
Leo 很喜歡鳥，所以吃完早餐後，我們會帶他去河邊的公園。那裡有一座老橋，很多鳥會停在高大樹木的樹枝上。我們會帶一條毯子，一起坐在草地上。我相信這會是他有史以來最棒的生日。

questions.stem: What did Leo think of last year's birthday present?
options: He gave it to his sister.
questions.explain: 第一段說去年送的書 Leo 覺得無聊，而且從沒讀過，故選 (A)。(D) 說他讀了很多次，與 never read it 相反。
questions.evidence: Last year, we gave him a book, but he said it was boring and never read it.

questions.stem: What will the writer make for Leo?
questions.explain: 第二段說作者會用舊箱子做一個生日牌子，故選 (B)。(A) 烤麵包的是姊姊，不是作者。
questions.evidence: I will build a small birthday sign from an old box and paint his name on it.

questions.stem: Why will they take Leo to the park by the river?
options: Leo wants to swim in the river.
The park is next to a bookstore.
Leo can see many birds there.
They want to borrow a camera there.
questions.explain: Leo 喜歡鳥，而河邊公園的樹上有很多鳥，可知是為了讓他看鳥，故選 (C)。(D) 相機是向鄰居借，與公園無關。
questions.evidence: Leo loves birds, so after breakfast we will take him to the park by the river.

questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?
options: Why Leo does not like books
How to take good photos of birds
A trip the family took last year
A plan for a younger brother's birthday
questions.explain: 全文說明作者和姊姊為弟弟生日準備早餐、牌子和公園行程，故選 (D)。(C) 文章講的是下週的計畫，不是去年的旅行。
questions.evidence: This year, my sister and I want to do something different for him.

vocab.stem: I forgot my umbrella. Can I ______ yours for a day?
vocab.explain: 忘了帶傘，想「借用」對方的傘一天，故選 borrow。bring（帶來）不是「借用」的意思，boil（煮沸）、build（建造）不合句意。

vocab.stem: The movie was so ______ that half of the people fell asleep.
vocab.explain: 電影太「無聊」，一半的人都睡著了，故選 boring。brave（勇敢的）、bright（明亮的）、busy（忙碌的）都不會讓人睡著。

title: No Camp This Weekend
paragraphs: Our club planned a two-day [[camp|J-0218]] in the mountains this weekend. I marked the date on my [[calendar|J-0214]] a month ago and could not wait. But on Thursday, our teacher [[called|J-0215]] all of us to a meeting. "A typhoon is coming," she said. "We have to [[cancel|J-0220]] the camp." Everyone felt sad.

Our teacher stayed [[calm|J-0216]]. She explained that heavy rain can [[cause|J-0237]] big problems in the mountains. "Your safety is the most important thing," she said. "Please be [[careful|J-0228]] and stay home this weekend." She also promised that we would have another [[chance|J-0249]] to go next month.

On Saturday, the wind was strong, so I stayed home with my [[cat|J-0235]]. I watched [[cartoons|J-0231]] and helped my sister make a [[cake|J-0213]] with [[carrots|J-0229]] in it. My little [[brother|J-0192]] was [[brave|J-0185]] and not afraid of the loud wind. I sent photos of our cake to my club friends on my [[cellphone|J-0240]]. Plans can [[change|J-0250]], but a rainy day at home can still be fun.
zh: 我們社團原本計畫這個週末到山上露營兩天。我一個月前就在月曆上做了記號，等不及要去了。但星期四，老師把我們全部叫去開會。「颱風要來了，」她說，「我們必須取消露營。」大家都很難過。
老師很冷靜。她解釋說，大雨可能會在山區造成大問題。「你們的安全最重要，」她說，「這個週末請小心，待在家裡。」她也答應我們下個月還有機會去。
星期六風很大，所以我和我的貓待在家裡。我看卡通，也幫姊姊做了一個加了胡蘿蔔的蛋糕。我的弟弟很勇敢，一點也不怕呼呼的風聲。我用手機把蛋糕的照片傳給社團朋友。計畫會改變，但在家度過的雨天還是可以很有趣。

questions.stem: Why was the camp canceled?
options: Not many students wanted to go.
The camp cost too much money.
questions.explain: 第一段老師說颱風要來，所以必須取消露營，故選 (D)。(A) 老師並沒有生病，還親自開會說明。
questions.evidence: "A typhoon is coming," she said.

questions.stem: The word "calm" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to ______.
questions.explain: calm 是「冷靜的」，老師沒有慌張，平靜地解釋原因，故選 (B)。(C) 很難過的是學生，不是老師。
questions.evidence: Our teacher stayed calm.

questions.stem: What did the writer do on Saturday?
options: The writer helped make a cake at home.
The writer went camping with friends.
The writer bought a new cellphone.
The writer went to the mountains.
questions.explain: 第三段說作者星期六在家看卡通，並幫姊姊做胡蘿蔔蛋糕，故選 (A)。(C) 手機是用來傳照片，不是新買的。
questions.evidence: I watched cartoons and helped my sister make a cake with carrots in it.

questions.stem: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: Camping in the mountains is always dangerous.
Cats are afraid of strong wind.
A camp was canceled, but the writer still had a good day at home.
questions.explain: 全文寫露營因颱風取消，但作者在家仍過得很開心，最後一句點出主旨，故選 (C)。(A) 用了 always，太過絕對，文中只說颱風時山區危險。
questions.evidence: Plans can change, but a rainy day at home can still be fun.

vocab.stem: The floor is wet. Please be ______ when you walk.
vocab.explain: 地板濕濕的，走路要「小心」，故選 careful。certain（確定的）、central（中央的）不合句意；calm（冷靜的）也不是在提醒注意安全。

vocab.stem: This is your last ______ to finish the test, so do your best.
vocab.explain: 這是你完成考試的最後「機會」，故選 chance。cartoon（卡通）、calendar（月曆）、cause（原因）都不合句意。

title: Starting My Own Club
paragraphs: At the start of the new school year, every student had to [[choose|J-0270]] a [[club|J-0291]]. There were many [[choices|J-0269]]: dance, guitar, [[chess|J-0260]], and even a mountain [[climbing|J-0285]] club. My [[classmate|J-0279]] Emma joined the music club right away because she loves [[classical|J-0278]] music.

I was not sure. Since my [[childhood|J-0263]], I have liked to [[collect|J-0299]] old [[coins|J-0296]], so I looked for a club about that. An older student showed me a [[chart|J-0254]] of all the clubs. "There is no coin club," she said, "but you can start one!" I was surprised, but I was also [[careful|J-0228]] to ask a teacher first. He said it was a good idea.

The next week, I put a notice on the wall of our [[classroom|J-0280]]. Five students joined me. At our first meeting, we sat in a [[circle|J-0274]] and showed our coins. When I talked about my oldest coin, from the last [[century|J-0245]], everyone began to [[clap|J-0276]]. Now I am [[certain|J-0247]] that I made a good start.
zh: 新學年開始時，每個學生都得選一個社團。選擇很多：舞蹈、吉他、西洋棋，甚至還有登山社。我的同學 Emma 馬上加入了音樂社，因為她很喜歡古典音樂。
我拿不定主意。我從小就喜歡收集舊硬幣，所以想找跟這有關的社團。一位學姊給我看所有社團的一覽表。「沒有錢幣社，」她說，「但你可以自己創一個！」我很驚訝，但也很謹慎地先去問老師。老師說這是個好主意。
隔週，我在教室牆上貼了一張公告，有五位同學加入。第一次聚會時，我們圍坐成一圈，展示各自的硬幣。當我介紹我最老的一枚、來自上個世紀的硬幣時，大家都開始拍手。現在我很確定，我有了一個好的開始。

questions.stem: Why did Emma join the music club?
options: Her friend asked her to join.
The club had a lot of coins.
questions.explain: 第一段說 Emma 加入音樂社是因為她喜歡古典音樂，故選 (D)。(B) 西洋棋社只是社團選項之一，與 Emma 無關。
questions.evidence: My classmate Emma joined the music club right away because she loves classical music.

questions.stem: In paragraph 2, what does "one" in "you can start one" refer to?
questions.explain: 學姊先說沒有錢幣社，接著說「你可以創一個」，one 指的是錢幣社，故選 (A)。(C) 舊硬幣不能用 start 來搭配。
questions.evidence: "There is no coin club," she said, "but you can start one!"

questions.stem: Why did everyone clap at the first meeting?
options: The writer told a funny story.
They liked the writer's very old coin.
The teacher gave them a prize.
questions.explain: 作者介紹上個世紀的老硬幣時大家開始拍手，可推知大家很喜歡這枚硬幣，故選 (B)。(C) 文中沒有說聚會結束。
questions.evidence: When I talked about my oldest coin, from the last century, everyone began to clap.

questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?
options: How the writer started a new club at school
A chess game between two classmates
questions.explain: 全文寫作者找不到喜歡的社團，於是自己創立錢幣社的經過，故選 (C)。(A) 收集硬幣是背景，文章沒有教人怎麼收集。
questions.evidence: Now I am certain that I made a good start.

vocab.stem: It's hard to ______ a gift for my friend because she already has everything.
vocab.explain: 朋友什麼都有，所以很難「挑選」禮物，故選 choose。clap（拍手）、climb（爬）不合句意；collect（收集）也不是挑一份禮物的意思。

vocab.stem: When the singer finished her song, the people in the hall began to ______ their hands.
vocab.explain: 歌手唱完歌，大家開始「拍手」，clap one's hands 是固定說法，故選 clap。clean（清潔）、close（關閉）、check（檢查）都不合句意。

title: Basketball with My Cousin
paragraphs: My [[cousin|J-0334]] Jack lives in another [[country|J-0330]], and he visited Taiwan last week. He is my age, and we both love basketball. On Saturday afternoon, the sky was [[clear|J-0282]], so we went to the [[court|J-0333]] near my house. A big [[crowd|J-0344]] was already there, watching a game.

After a [[couple|J-0331]] of minutes, two players asked us to join them. At first, I did not feel [[confident|J-0311]] because they were tall and fast. Jack said, "Do not [[compare|J-0309]] yourself with them. Just have fun." So I did. We played for an hour, and I scored six points. The crowd [[cheered|J-0258]] for us!

When the game ended, our [[clothes|J-0288]] were wet, and we were hot. We bought ice [[cream|J-0340]] at a [[convenience store|J-0316]] on the [[corner|J-0324]]. Then we went home and rested on the [[couch|J-0327]]. We read [[comics|J-0305]] and had a long [[conversation|J-0318]] about school life in our two countries. "Of [[course|J-0332]] I will come back next year," Jack said.
zh: 我的表哥 Jack 住在另一個國家，上星期來台灣玩。他跟我同年，我們都很愛打籃球。星期六下午天氣晴朗，我們就去我家附近的球場。那裡已經有一大群人在看比賽。
過了幾分鐘，有兩位球員邀我們一起打。一開始我沒什麼自信，因為他們又高又快。Jack 說：「別拿自己跟他們比，開心玩就好。」於是我照做了。我們打了一個小時，我拿了六分。觀眾還為我們歡呼！
比賽結束時，我們的衣服都濕了，全身很熱。我們在轉角的便利商店買了冰淇淋。然後我們回家，躺在沙發上休息。我們一邊看漫畫，一邊聊了很久兩個國家的學校生活。「我明年當然還會再來。」Jack 說。

questions.stem: Where did the writer and Jack buy ice cream?
options: At a convenience store on the corner
questions.explain: 第三段說他們在轉角的便利商店買冰淇淋，故選 (C)。(A) 球場是打球的地方，文中沒有說在那裡買東西。
questions.evidence: We bought ice cream at a convenience store on the corner.

questions.stem: The word "confident" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to ______.
questions.explain: confident 是「有自信的」，也就是對自己有把握，作者因對手高又快而沒信心，故選 (A)。(D) tall and fast 是在描述對手，不是 confident 的意思。
questions.evidence: At first, I did not feel confident because they were tall and fast.

questions.stem: What can we learn about Jack from his words in paragraph 2?
options: He wants the writer to enjoy the game.
He thinks the other players are bad.
He is afraid of the crowd.
questions.explain: Jack 叫作者別和別人比，開心玩就好，可見他希望作者享受比賽，故選 (B)。(C) Jack 並沒有說對手打得不好。
questions.evidence: Just have fun.

questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?
options: How to become a basketball player
Why ice cream is popular in summer
A fun day the writer spent with a cousin
questions.explain: 全文寫作者和來訪的表哥一起打球、吃冰、聊天的一天，故選 (D)。(C) 聊學校生活只是最後的一個小細節。
questions.evidence: "Of course I will come back next year," Jack said.

vocab.stem: There was a big ______ of people outside the store on the first day of the sale.
vocab.explain: 特賣第一天店外有一大「群」人，a crowd of people 是常見說法，故選 crowd。couch（沙發）、court（球場）、corner（角落）都不能接 of people。

vocab.stem: Please don't ______ me with my brother. We are different people.
vocab.explain: compare A with B 是「拿 A 和 B 比較」，請別拿我和哥哥比，故選 compare。count（數）、cover（覆蓋）、cut（切）都不合句意。

title: Dad's New Diet
paragraphs: Last month, my dad went to see a [[doctor|J-0400]]. The doctor said, "Your heart is fine, but you eat too much fried food. You need a better [[diet|J-0385]]." Dad was surprised. He [[decided|J-0365]] to change his habits, and our family wanted to help him.

[[Changing|J-0250]] was [[difficult|J-0387]] at first. Dad loves [[delicious|J-0370]] fried [[chicken|J-0261]] from the night market. My mom and I [[discovered|J-0395]] some easy ways to cook vegetables on the Internet. Every evening, we [[cook|J-0319]] [[dinner|J-0391]] together. I cut the vegetables, and Mom makes a fish [[dish|J-0397]] with little oil. We eat at the table in the [[dining room|J-0390]], not in front of the TV. We also [[divide|J-0399]] the food and put it on small plates, so nobody eats too much.

It was a big [[decision|J-0366]], but it was a good one. After four weeks, Dad feels [[different|J-0386]]. He has more energy and walks to work every day. He even writes down his meals in a small [[diary|J-0381]]. Last night he said, "My dear [[daughter|J-0357]], thank you for your help." I smiled. Healthy food can taste good, too.
zh: 上個月，我爸爸去看醫生。醫生說：「你的心臟沒問題，但你吃太多油炸食物了。你需要更好的飲食。」爸爸很驚訝。他決定改變自己的習慣，而我們全家都想幫他。
一開始，改變很困難。爸爸很愛夜市好吃的炸雞。媽媽和我在網路上發現了一些煮蔬菜的簡單方法。每天晚上，我們一起煮晚餐。我切菜，媽媽用很少的油做一道魚料理。我們在飯廳的餐桌吃飯，而不是在電視前面。我們也把食物分到小盤子裡，這樣就沒有人會吃太多。
這是個重大的決定，但是個好決定。四個星期後，爸爸覺得不一樣了。他更有精神，而且每天走路去上班。他甚至在一本小日記裡記下自己吃的每一餐。昨晚他說：「我親愛的女兒，謝謝妳的幫忙。」我笑了。健康的食物也可以很好吃。

questions.stem: Why did the doctor ask Dad to change his diet?
options: He did not eat enough vegetables at work.
He ate too much fried food.
He walked too much every day.
questions.explain: 第一段醫生說爸爸的心臟沒問題，但吃太多油炸食物，故選 (C)。醫生明說 Your heart is fine，所以 (A) 心臟很弱是錯的。
questions.evidence: The doctor said, "Your heart is fine, but you eat too much fried food.

questions.stem: The word "divide" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to ______.
questions.explain: divide 是「分開、分配」，把食物分到小盤子裡，就是 put into parts，故選 (B)。(A) throw away 是「丟掉」，文中並沒有把食物丟掉。
questions.evidence: We also divide the food and put it on small plates, so nobody eats too much.

questions.stem: What can we learn about Dad after four weeks?
options: He wants to go back to fried chicken.
He is angry with his family.
He goes to the night market every night.
He is healthier and happier than before.
questions.explain: 第三段說爸爸覺得不一樣、更有精神，還每天走路上班並謝謝女兒，可推知他比以前更健康、開心，故選 (D)。(C) 文中沒有說他每晚去夜市，反而是全家在家煮晚餐。
questions.evidence: He has more energy and walks to work every day.

questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?
options: A family helps Dad eat in a healthier way.
A doctor teaches people how to cook fish.
A girl writes a diary about the night market.
A family buys a new table for the dining room.
questions.explain: 全文講爸爸聽了醫生的話改變飲食，家人一起幫忙煮健康的晚餐，故選 (A)。(C) 寫日記的是爸爸，而且記的是自己的餐點，不是夜市。
questions.evidence: He decided to change his habits, and our family wanted to help him.

vocab.stem: The math test was so ______ that many students could not finish it.
vocab.explain: 考試太「難」，所以很多學生寫不完，difficult 最通順，故選 difficult。delicious（美味的）、dirty（髒的）不能形容考試；different（不同的）也無法說明寫不完的原因。

vocab.stem: Grandma writes about her day in her ______ every night before bed.
vocab.explain: 每晚睡前在「日記」裡寫下一天的事，故選 diary。dish（盤子、菜餚）、desk（書桌）、doctor（醫生）都不能「在裡面寫」一天的事。

title: The Earthquake Drill
paragraphs: Last Tuesday, our school had an [[earthquake|J-0438]] drill. At 10 a.m., an [[alarm|J-0035]] rang [[during|J-0428]] English class. Our teacher said, "Get down, [[cover|J-0335]] your head, and hold on!" We hid under our desks. My heart was beating so loudly that I could hear it in my [[ears|J-0433]].

Then we walked [[downstairs|J-0411]] to the playground. Nobody ran, and nobody pushed. [[Each|J-0431]] class leader had one [[duty|J-0429]]: to count the students. Mia [[dropped|J-0423]] her water bottle on the stairs, but she did not go back for it. Our teacher said that was the right choice.

After the drill, Mr. Lin talked about safety at home. "Keep a bag near the [[door|J-0405]]," he said. "Put water, food, and a flashlight in it. When the ground shakes, stay [[calm|J-0216]]." He also said that Taiwan has many earthquakes because of where it is on the [[earth|J-0437]]. That night, I wrote an [[e-mail|J-0430]] to my aunt about the drill. Then my parents and I made our own bag together. Now I feel more at [[ease|J-0439]]. Getting ready is [[easy|J-0442]] if you start [[early|J-0434]].
zh: 上星期二，我們學校舉行了地震演習。上午十點，英文課上警報響起。老師說：「趴下、掩護頭部、穩住！」我們躲到桌子底下。我的心跳得好大聲，連耳朵都聽得到。
接著我們走下樓到操場。沒有人奔跑，也沒有人推擠。每班班長都有一項任務：清點學生人數。Mia 在樓梯上掉了水壺，但她沒有回頭去撿。老師說那是正確的選擇。
演習結束後，林老師談到居家安全。「在門邊放一個包包，」他說。「裡面放水、食物和一支手電筒。地面搖晃時，要保持冷靜。」他還說，因為台灣在地球上的位置，所以地震很多。那天晚上，我寫了一封電子郵件給阿姨，告訴她演習的事。接著我和爸媽一起準備了我們自己的包包。現在我覺得比較安心了。只要提早開始，做好準備其實很容易。

questions.stem: What was the class leader's duty during the drill?
questions.explain: 第二段說每班班長的任務是清點學生人數，故選 (D)。(B) Mia 的水壺掉了，但文中說她沒有回去撿，也沒有人被派去找。
questions.evidence: Each class leader had one duty: to count the students.

questions.stem: Why did the teacher say Mia made the right choice?
options: Going back during an earthquake can be dangerous.
The water bottle was too old to keep.
Mia wanted to buy a new bottle.
The teacher did not like water bottles.
questions.explain: 演習時大家要快速、安全地離開大樓，回頭撿東西可能有危險，所以老師稱讚 Mia 沒回去撿，故選 (A)。(B) 文中完全沒提到水壺新舊。
questions.evidence: Mia dropped her water bottle on the stairs, but she did not go back for it.

questions.stem: The phrase "at ease" in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to ______.
questions.explain: 準備好防災包後，作者覺得比較 at ease，也就是「安心、不害怕」，故選 (B)。(A) worried（擔心的）意思正好相反。
questions.evidence: Now I feel more at ease.

questions.stem: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: English class is the best class of the day.
An earthquake drill taught the writer to be ready.
Mia lost her water bottle and felt sad.
questions.explain: 全文從學校地震演習寫到作者回家和爸媽準備防災包，重點是學會事先做好準備，故選 (C)。(D) 掉水壺只是演習中的一個小細節。
questions.evidence: Getting ready is easy if you start early.

vocab.stem: Ben sends an ______ to his teacher when he has a question about homework.
vocab.explain: 有作業問題時「寄電子郵件」給老師，send an e-mail 是常見搭配，故選 e-mail。ear（耳朵）、earth（地球）、egg（蛋）都不能「寄給老師」問問題。

vocab.stem: Please do not use your phone ______ the movie. It may bother other people.
vocab.explain: 「在電影播放期間」不要用手機，during 表示「在……期間」，後面接名詞 the movie，故選 during。early、easy 是形容詞或副詞，each 是「每個」，都不能接在這裡。

title: Leo's Study Plan
paragraphs: Leo's [[English|J-0462]] [[exam|J-0480]] was on Friday, and he was worried. On the last test, he made many [[errors|J-0468]], [[especially|J-0469]] in grammar. He was afraid that he would [[fail|J-0498]] again. He told his friend Emma, "I study hard, but it is never [[enough|J-0464]]."

Emma gave him some advice. "First, study a little every day. Do not try to learn [[everything|J-0477]] in one night. Second, use a [[dictionary|J-0382]] and write your own [[examples|J-0481]] for new words. Third, take a [[break|J-0187]] and get some [[exercise|J-0488]]. Your body and mind need a rest, too." Leo followed her plan. Every [[evening|J-0472]], he studied for one hour and then went for a walk in the park.

On the day of the exam, Leo [[entered|J-0465]] the classroom with a calm [[face|J-0495]]. He felt [[confident|J-0311]]. A week later, the teacher gave back the tests. Leo got 88 points, and she wrote "[[Excellent|J-0482]] work!" next to his name. Leo was so [[excited|J-0485]] that he showed it to Emma right away. "Your plan really works," he said. "Thank you!"
zh: Leo 的英文考試就在星期五，他很擔心。上次考試他錯了很多地方，尤其是文法。他害怕自己又會不及格。他對朋友 Emma 說：「我很用功讀書，但好像永遠都不夠。」
Emma 給了他一些建議。「第一，每天讀一點。不要想在一個晚上把所有東西都學完。第二，查字典，並替新單字寫自己的例句。第三，休息一下，做點運動。你的身體和頭腦也需要休息。」Leo 照著她的計畫做。每天傍晚，他讀書一個小時，然後去公園散步。
考試那天，Leo 帶著平靜的表情走進教室。他覺得很有信心。一星期後，老師發回考卷。Leo 考了 88 分，老師在他的名字旁邊寫著「表現優異！」。Leo 興奮得馬上拿給 Emma 看。「妳的計畫真的有用，」他說。「謝謝妳！」

questions.stem: On the last test, what part was especially hard for Leo?
questions.explain: 第一段說他上次考試錯很多，尤其是文法（grammar），故選 (B)。(D) 他考的是英文，不是數學。
questions.evidence: On the last test, he made many errors, especially in grammar.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT part of Emma's advice?
options: Write your own examples for new words.
Take a break and get some exercise.
questions.explain: Emma 說「不要」想在一個晚上學完所有東西，所以 (D) 不是她的建議，故選 (D)。(A)(B)(C) 都是她提到的第一、二、三點。
questions.evidence: Do not try to learn everything in one night.

questions.stem: In paragraph 3, what does "it" in "he showed it to Emma" refer to?
questions.explain: 前一句說老師發回考卷，在上面寫了「表現優異！」，Leo 興奮地拿給 Emma 看的就是考卷，故選 (A)。(B) 字典是讀書時用的，與這裡無關。
questions.evidence: Leo was so excited that he showed it to Emma right away.

questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?
options: Emma teaches English at a school.
Leo stops studying and walks in the park.
A good study plan helps Leo do well on his exam.
Leo fails his English exam again.
questions.explain: 全文寫 Leo 擔心考試，照著 Emma 的讀書計畫準備，最後考得很好，故選 (C)。(D) 與結果相反，他得到 88 分和老師的稱讚。
questions.evidence: "Your plan really works," he said.

vocab.stem: Please take off your shoes before you ______ the house.
vocab.explain: 「進入」房子前請脫鞋，enter 是「進入」，故選 enter。fail（失敗）、excite（使興奮）、exercise（運動）都不能接 the house 表示走進去。

vocab.stem: Ken does not have ______ money to buy the new phone, so he is saving his money.
vocab.explain: 錢「不夠」買新手機所以在存錢，enough money 是「足夠的錢」，故選 enough。empty（空的）不能放在 money 前這樣用；early、else 意思不通。

title: A Flat Tire by the Sea
paragraphs: Last Saturday, Ben and his cousin Ken rode their [[bikes|J-0151]] along the east [[coast|J-0292]] of Taiwan. It was their first long bike trip. In the morning, there was some [[fog|J-0545]] over the sea, so they did not ride [[fast|J-0508]]. Soon the sun came out, and they saw [[flowers|J-0542]] everywhere.

After two hours, Ken's bike had a [[flat tire|J-0540]]. They were [[far|J-0505]] from any town, and Ken did not know how to [[fix|J-0538]] it. Then an old [[fisherman|J-0535]] walked by. "Do not worry," he said. "[[Follow|J-0546]] me." He took them to his house and helped them fix the bike in a [[few|J-0520]] minutes.

The fisherman's wife even gave them some [[food|J-0547]]: rice and fresh [[fish|J-0534]]. It was [[delicious|J-0370]]. Ben and Ken thanked them again and again. In the afternoon, they [[finally|J-0527]] [[finished|J-0531]] the trip. "The bike trouble was bad, but meeting that kind couple was my [[favorite|J-0511]] part of the day," Ken said. "Kind people are everywhere."
zh: 上星期六，Ben 和他的表弟 Ken 騎腳踏車沿著台灣東海岸前進。這是他們第一次長途單車旅行。早上海面上有些霧，所以他們騎得不快。不久太陽出來了，他們看到到處都是花。
兩個小時後，Ken 的腳踏車爆胎了。他們離任何城鎮都很遠，而 Ken 不知道怎麼修。這時一位老漁夫走了過來。「別擔心，」他說。「跟我來。」他帶他們到自己家，幾分鐘就幫他們把腳踏車修好了。
漁夫的太太甚至給了他們一些食物：米飯和新鮮的魚。真的很好吃。Ben 和 Ken 一再向他們道謝。下午，他們終於完成了這趟旅行。「腳踏車出問題很倒楣，但遇到那對親切的夫婦是我今天最喜歡的部分，」Ken 說。「好心人到處都有。」

questions.stem: Why did Ben and Ken not ride fast in the morning?
options: Ken's bike had a flat tire.
They wanted to look at the flowers.
There was some fog over the sea.
questions.explain: 第一段說早上海面有霧，所以他們騎得不快，故選 (D)。(B) 爆胎是兩小時後才發生的事，不是早上騎得慢的原因。
questions.evidence: In the morning, there was some fog over the sea, so they did not ride fast.

questions.stem: How did the fisherman help Ben and Ken?
options: He helped them fix the bike.
He gave them a new bike.
He showed them the way to the beach.
questions.explain: 第二段說漁夫帶他們回家，幾分鐘內就幫他們修好腳踏車，故選 (A)。(B) 他並沒有送他們新腳踏車，只是修好舊的。
questions.evidence: He took them to his house and helped them fix the bike in a few minutes.

questions.stem: In paragraph 3, who does "that kind couple" refer to?
questions.explain: 幫忙修車又請他們吃飯的是漁夫和他的太太，所以「那對親切的夫婦」指的是他們，故選 (C)。(A) Ben 和 Ken 是受到幫助、向人道謝的一方，不是被稱讚的那對夫婦。
questions.evidence: The fisherman's wife even gave them some food: rice and fresh fish.

questions.stem: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: Riding a bike in the fog is fun.
Two boys meet kind people during a bike trip.
A fisherman teaches boys how to catch fish.
The east coast has the best food in Taiwan.
questions.explain: 全文寫 Ben 和 Ken 單車旅行時爆胎，受到漁夫夫婦幫助，最後說好心人到處都有，故選 (B)。(C) 漁夫是幫忙修車，沒有教他們捕魚。
questions.evidence: "Kind people are everywhere."

vocab.stem: My computer does not work. Can you help me ______ it?
vocab.explain: 電腦壞了，請人幫忙「修理」，fix 是「修理」，故選 fix。fill（裝滿）、fly（飛）、follow（跟隨）都不合文意。

vocab.stem: After three hours of hard work, Mia ______ finished her art project.
vocab.explain: 努力了三個小時之後「終於」完成作品，finally 是「終於、最後」，故選 finally。foolish（愚蠢的）是形容詞，不能修飾動詞 finished；fast、far 意思不通。

title: A New Friend from Far Away
paragraphs: This semester, a [[foreign|J-0553]] student named Anna joined our class. On her first day, she stood in [[front|J-0580]] of the class and said hello in Chinese. She was a little nervous, and her Chinese was not perfect, but everybody [[clapped|J-0276]]. Our teacher asked me to help Anna, and I was [[glad|J-0600]] to do it.

Anna is very [[friendly|J-0574]] and [[funny|J-0585]]. At lunch, she tells us about her country, where the winter is [[freezing|J-0568]]. She thinks Taiwan is warm and fun. In our [[free|J-0567]] time, we play [[frisbee|J-0577]] on the playground. On Friday nights, we go to the night market together. She loves [[fresh|J-0570]] [[fruit|J-0581]], [[especially|J-0469]] mangoes. She can eat five in one night!

Next month, Anna will go back to her country. I will never [[forget|J-0556]] her. I made a small [[gift|J-0597]] for her: a photo [[album|J-0036]] of our class. I hope our [[friendship|J-0575]] will last for a long time. Maybe in the [[future|J-0587]], I can visit her country and see the snow there.
zh: 這學期，一位名叫 Anna 的外國學生加入我們班。她第一天站在全班面前，用中文打招呼。她有點緊張，中文也不完美，但大家都為她鼓掌。老師請我幫忙 Anna，我很樂意。
Anna 非常友善又很有趣。午餐時，她會跟我們聊她的國家，那裡的冬天冷得要命。她覺得台灣既溫暖又好玩。空閒時間，我們在操場玩飛盤。星期五晚上，我們一起去逛夜市。她很愛新鮮水果，尤其是芒果。她一個晚上可以吃五顆！
下個月，Anna 就要回她的國家了。我永遠不會忘記她。我替她做了一份小禮物：一本我們班的相簿。我希望我們的友誼能長長久久。也許將來，我可以去拜訪她的國家，看看那裡的雪。

questions.stem: What did Anna do on her first day?
options: She played frisbee with the teacher.
She went to the night market alone.
She said hello in Chinese in front of the class.
questions.explain: 第一段說她第一天站在全班面前用中文打招呼，故選 (C)。(D) 送禮物的是作者，而且是在 Anna 要回國前。
questions.evidence: On her first day, she stood in front of the class and said hello in Chinese.

questions.stem: The word "freezing" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to ______.
questions.explain: freezing 是「冷得要命、極冷的」，與 very cold 最接近，故選 (A)。(C) very hot 正好相反，文中說的是台灣溫暖，而 Anna 的國家冬天很冷。
questions.evidence: At lunch, she tells us about her country, where the winter is freezing.

questions.stem: What can we learn about Anna?
options: She does not like Taiwanese food.
She really enjoys fruit in Taiwan.
She wants to live in Taiwan.
questions.explain: 文中說她很愛新鮮水果，尤其是芒果，一個晚上能吃五顆，可知她很喜歡台灣的水果，故選 (B)。(D) 第一段明說她的中文不完美。
questions.evidence: She can eat five in one night!

questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?
options: How to play frisbee on the playground.
Why winter is cold in other countries.
The best night market in Taiwan.
The writer's friendship with a foreign student.
questions.explain: 全文寫作者幫助外國同學 Anna、一起玩、一起逛夜市，最後希望友誼長久，故選 (D)。(A) 玩飛盤只是兩人一起做的活動之一。
questions.evidence: I hope our friendship will last for a long time.

vocab.stem: Do not ______ to bring your umbrella. It is going to rain this afternoon.
vocab.explain: 「別忘了」帶傘，下午要下雨，Do not forget to... 是「別忘了要……」，故選 forget。forgive（原諒）字形相近但意思不同；fry（油炸）、free（自由的）都不通。

vocab.stem: The new clerk at the store is very ______. She always smiles and says hello to everyone.
vocab.explain: 總是微笑、跟每個人打招呼，表示她很「友善」，故選 friendly。funny 是「好笑的」，微笑打招呼不等於好笑；full（飽的）、foreign（外國的）不合文意。

title: Summer on Grandpa's Farm
paragraphs: Every summer vacation, I visit my [[grandpa|J-0620]] and grandma in a small village in Tainan. They have a farm with two [[goats|J-0606]] and a [[goose|J-0612]]. When I [[arrive|J-0079]], the goose always runs out to [[greet|J-0627]] me. It makes loud noises, as if I were a very special [[guest|J-0634]].

Grandpa is seventy, but he still works hard. He [[grows|J-0630]] [[guavas|J-0632]] and [[grapes|J-0622]]. Every morning, he puts on his [[gloves|J-0603]] and works in the [[garden|J-0590]] until noon. I help him pick fruit. One day, I asked him, "How do you know when a guava is ready?" He smiled and said, "[[Guess|J-0633]]." Then he showed me. A ready guava is light [[green|J-0626]], not too hard, and it smells sweet.

In the evening, we sit on the [[ground|J-0628]] under a big tree and eat fruit. Grandma [[hangs|J-0650]] a lamp on the tree, and the old gray cat sleeps next to us. Grandpa says that working outside every day is his best [[habit|J-0639]]. I think he is right. Life on the farm is slow, but it is great.
zh: 每年暑假，我都會去台南一個小村莊看爺爺和奶奶。他們有一座農場，養了兩隻山羊和一隻鵝。我一到，那隻鵝總是跑出來迎接我。牠會大聲叫，好像我是一位非常特別的客人。
爺爺七十歲了，但仍然很勤勞地工作。他種芭樂和葡萄。每天早上，他戴上手套在園子裡工作到中午。我幫他採水果。有一天我問他：「你怎麼知道芭樂熟了沒？」他笑著說：「你猜猜看。」然後他示範給我看。熟的芭樂是淺綠色的，不會太硬，而且聞起來甜甜的。
傍晚，我們坐在大樹下的地上吃水果。奶奶在樹上掛一盞燈，那隻灰色的老貓就睡在我們旁邊。爺爺說，每天在戶外工作是他最好的習慣。我覺得他說得對。農場上的生活很慢，但很棒。

questions.stem: What does the goose do when the writer arrives?
options: It sleeps next to the cat.
It runs out to greet the writer.
questions.explain: 第一段說作者一到，鵝總是跑出來迎接，故選 (D)。(B) 睡在旁邊的是灰色老貓，不是鵝。
questions.evidence: When I arrive, the goose always runs out to greet me.

questions.stem: How can you tell that a guava is ready?
options: It is light green and smells sweet.
It is dark and very hard.
It is as big as a grape.
questions.explain: 第二段爺爺示範：熟的芭樂是淺綠色、不會太硬、聞起來甜，故選 (A)。(B) 文中說熟的芭樂「不會太硬」，與 very hard 相反。
questions.evidence: A ready guava is light green, not too hard, and it smells sweet.

questions.stem: What kind of person is Grandpa?
options: He is lazy and sleeps until noon.
He wants to move to a big city.
questions.explain: 爺爺七十歲仍每天早上工作到中午，還說戶外工作是他最好的習慣，可見他勤勞又健康，故選 (B)。(A) 他是工作「到中午」，不是睡到中午。
questions.evidence: Grandpa is seventy, but he still works hard.

questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?
options: How to take care of a goose.
Why grapes are better than guavas.
The writer's happy summer days on the grandparents' farm.
A trip to a big night market in Tainan.
questions.explain: 全文寫作者暑假到爺爺奶奶的農場，迎接的鵝、採芭樂、傍晚在樹下吃水果，結尾說農場生活很棒，故選 (C)。(A) 鵝只出現在第一段，不是全文重點。
questions.evidence: Life on the farm is slow, but it is great.

vocab.stem: Kevin has a good ______. He goes to bed early and gets up at six every day.
vocab.explain: 每天早睡早起是好「習慣」，habit 最通順，故選 habit。guest（客人）、ground（地面）、goose（鵝）都不能用來說早睡早起。

vocab.stem: Can you ______ what is in the box? It is round, and you can eat it.
vocab.explain: 請對方「猜」盒子裡是什麼，還給了提示，guess 是「猜」，故選 guess。greet（打招呼）、grow（種植、成長）、hang（掛）都不能接 what is in the box。

title: A Hot Day on the Hill
paragraphs: Hiking is my [[favorite|J-0511]] [[hobby|J-0685]]. During the last [[holiday|J-0688]], our school hiking club went to a [[hill|J-0679]] near Taichung. We met at the school [[gate|J-0591]] at seven and took a bus on the [[highway|J-0677]] for one hour.

The day was very [[hot|J-0697]]. Our teacher, Mr. Wang, told us to wear a [[hat|J-0655]] and drink enough water. On the way up, Lisa said she had a [[headache|J-0658]]. Her backpack was too [[heavy|J-0664]], and the [[heat|J-0663]] made her tired. Ben was very [[helpful|J-0668]]. He [[carried|J-0230]] some of her things, and we all rested under the trees for a while. Soon Lisa felt better, and we kept going.

At the top, we could see the whole city. Mr. Wang told us about the [[history|J-0683]] of the old road on the hill. Then we sat down and ate sandwiches and [[honey|J-0692]] cake. When I got home, I was tired but happy. Hiking is good for your [[health|J-0659]], and it is a great way to make friends. I [[hope|J-0694]] our next trip comes soon.
zh: 健行是我最喜歡的嗜好。上次放假時，我們學校的登山社去了台中附近的一座山丘。我們七點在校門口集合，搭巴士走高速公路一個小時。
那天非常熱。王老師叫我們戴帽子、喝足夠的水。上山途中，Lisa 說她頭痛。她的背包太重，炎熱也讓她很累。Ben 非常樂於助人。他幫她背了一些東西，我們大家也在樹下休息了一會兒。很快 Lisa 就好多了，我們繼續往上走。
到了山頂，我們可以看到整座城市。王老師跟我們介紹山上那條老路的歷史。接著我們坐下來吃三明治和蜂蜜蛋糕。回到家時，我很累但很開心。健行對健康有益，也是交朋友的好方法。我希望下一次的出遊快點到來。

questions.stem: Why did Lisa feel bad on the way up?
options: She forgot to bring her hat.
Her backpack was heavy, and it was very hot.
She did not like the other club members.
She ate too much honey cake.
questions.explain: 第二段說 Lisa 的背包太重，炎熱又讓她很累，所以頭痛，故選 (B)。(D) 蜂蜜蛋糕是到山頂後才吃的，與她頭痛無關。
questions.evidence: Her backpack was too heavy, and the heat made her tired.

questions.stem: The word "helpful" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to ______.
questions.explain: Ben 幫 Lisa 背東西，所以 helpful 指「樂於助人的」，與 kind and ready to help 最接近，故選 (D)。(B) tired 形容的是 Lisa，不是 Ben。
questions.evidence: Ben was very helpful.

questions.stem: What did Mr. Wang talk about at the top of the hill?
options: The history of the old road.
The way to make honey cake.
The bus ride on the highway.
questions.explain: 第三段說王老師在山頂介紹那條老路的歷史，故選 (A)。(D) 期待下一次出遊的是作者，不是老師說的話。
questions.evidence: Mr. Wang told us about the history of the old road on the hill.

questions.stem: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: Hiking on hot days is always dangerous.
Lisa should not join the hiking club.
The writer had a hot but happy hiking trip with the school club.
Taichung has the best highway in Taiwan.
questions.explain: 全文寫登山社在大熱天爬山，途中互相幫忙，最後開心地回家，故選 (C)。(A) 雖然天氣熱、Lisa 頭痛，但大家休息後就好了，文中沒有說熱天爬山總是很危險。
questions.evidence: When I got home, I was tired but happy.

vocab.stem: Emma's favorite ______ is drawing. She draws pictures in her free time.
vocab.explain: 空閒時間畫畫，是她最喜歡的「嗜好」，故選 hobby。hole（洞）、history（歷史）、highway（高速公路）都不合文意。

vocab.stem: This box is too ______ for me to carry. Can you help me?
vocab.explain: 箱子太「重」搬不動，需要幫忙，故選 heavy。high（高的）、honest（誠實的）不能說明搬不動；hot（燙的）也不是需要人幫忙「搬」的原因。

title: Meet Our New Classmate
paragraphs: This month, our school newspaper gave me a new [[job|J-0746]]. I had to [[interview|J-0737]] Emma, a new [[classmate|J-0279]] in our [[international|J-0735]] class. She comes from a small [[island|J-0741]] far away, and Taiwan is the first foreign [[country|J-0330]] she has lived in.

Emma is very [[independent|J-0726]]. She lives alone, cooks her own meals, and takes the bus to school by herself. I asked her, "What was your first [[idea|J-0715]] about Taiwan?" She laughed. "I [[imagined|J-0718]] that it was hot all year. But in [[January|J-0744]], I needed a warm [[jacket|J-0742]]!" Then she told a [[joke|J-0749]] about the big [[insects|J-0729]] in her room. "They are my only friends at home," she said.

Emma is also [[interested|J-0733]] in sports. Every morning, she [[jogs|J-0747]] around the school field before class. She hopes to [[join|J-0748]] the basketball team next week. At the end, I said, "You are really [[brave|J-0185]] to study in a new place." She smiled and answered, "Everyone here is so kind. I feel at home already."
zh: 這個月，校刊給了我一份新工作。我要訪問 Emma，她是我們國際班的新同學。她來自遙遠的一座小島，而台灣是她住過的第一個外國國家。
Emma 非常獨立。她一個人住，自己煮飯，也自己搭公車上學。我問她：「你對台灣的第一個想法是什麼？」她笑了。「我原本以為這裡一年到頭都很熱。可是到了一月，我需要一件保暖的夾克！」接著她說了一個關於她房間裡大蟲子的笑話。「牠們是我在家裡唯一的朋友。」她說。
Emma 也對運動很有興趣。每天早上，她會在上課前繞著學校操場慢跑。她希望下星期加入籃球隊。訪問最後，我說：「你真勇敢，敢到一個新地方讀書。」她笑著回答：「這裡每個人都好親切，我已經覺得像在家一樣了。」

questions.stem: What does Emma do every morning before class?
options: She cooks breakfast for her friends.
She plays basketball with the team.
She jogs around the school field.
She writes for the school newspaper.
questions.explain: 第三段說她每天早上上課前繞著操場慢跑，故選 (C)。她只是「希望下星期加入」籃球隊，還沒有開始打球，(B) 不對。
questions.evidence: Every morning, she jogs around the school field before class.

questions.stem: The word "independent" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to ______.
options: able to take care of herself
questions.explain: 後面一句說她一個人住、自己煮飯、自己搭公車，可見 independent 是「獨立、能照顧自己」，故選 (A)。她雖然會說笑話，但 (C) 不是這個字的意思。
questions.evidence: She lives alone, cooks her own meals, and takes the bus to school by herself.

questions.stem: In paragraph 2, what does "They" in "They are my only friends at home" refer to?
questions.explain: 前一句說她講了房間裡大蟲子的笑話，所以「牠們是我在家唯一的朋友」的 They 指蟲子，故選 (D)。她一個人住，同學不在她家，(A) 不對。
questions.evidence: Then she told a joke about the big insects in her room.

questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?
options: How to write a good school newspaper
An interview with a new student from another country
Why Taiwan is hot all year
How to join a basketball team
questions.explain: 全文是校刊記者訪問國際班新同學 Emma 的內容，故選 (B)。台灣一年到頭都熱只是 Emma 原本的想像，而且文中說一月其實很冷，(C) 不對。
questions.evidence: I had to interview Emma, a new classmate in our international class.

vocab.stem: Would you like to ______ our dance club? We practice every Friday.
vocab.explain: 邀請對方「加入」舞蹈社，join 最通順，故選 join。jog（慢跑）、joke（開玩笑）、hurry（趕快）都不能接 our dance club。

vocab.stem: It is very cold outside. Put on your ______ before you go out.
vocab.explain: 外面很冷，出門前要穿上「夾克」，故選 jacket。island（島）、insect（昆蟲）、idea（想法）都不能穿。

title: Lights on the Lake
paragraphs: Last Saturday was the Lantern [[Festival|J-0518]], so my [[family|J-0502]] went to a [[lantern|J-0782]] show by a [[large|J-0783]] [[lake|J-0777]] near our town. The roads were full of cars, and we got there [[late|J-0785]]. Luckily, the show had just started.

Hundreds of lanterns were floating on the water. My cousin Leo, a [[kid|J-0762]] of six, could not [[keep|J-0758]] still. He ran from one side to the other and shouted at every lantern. My favorite one was a white [[lamb|J-0778]] holding a small [[lamp|J-0779]]. A [[lady|J-0776]] next to us said an old man made it by hand. My [[grandmother|J-0619]] told us that long ago, people carried lanterns to [[lead|J-0793]] the way on dark roads.

Before we left, Dad bought us some cold [[juice|J-0752]]. In the car, Leo was so tired that he [[laid|J-0791]] his head on my [[knee|J-0770]] and fell asleep in a minute. Looking at the lights outside the window, I [[learned|J-0796]] something: a small light can make a dark night warm. Next year, we will come early!
zh: 上星期六是元宵節，所以我們一家人到我們鎮附近一座大湖邊看燈會。路上滿滿都是車，我們到得很晚。幸好燈會才剛開始。
幾百盞燈籠漂在水面上。我的表弟 Leo 才六歲，根本安靜不下來。他從這一頭跑到那一頭，對每一盞燈籠大叫。我最喜歡的是一隻提著小燈的白色小羊。旁邊一位女士說，那是一位老爺爺親手做的。奶奶告訴我們，很久以前，人們會提著燈籠在黑暗的路上帶路。
離開前，爸爸買了冰涼的果汁給我們。在車上，Leo 累到把頭靠在我的膝蓋上，一下子就睡著了。看著窗外的燈光，我學到一件事：一盞小小的燈，就能讓黑夜變得溫暖。明年我們要早點來！

questions.stem: Why did the family get to the lantern show late?
options: Leo was sleeping in the car.
The roads were full of cars.
They went to buy juice first.
They could not find the lake.
questions.explain: 第一段說路上滿是車，所以到得很晚，故選 (B)。Leo 是回家的路上才睡著，(A) 時間不對。
questions.evidence: The roads were full of cars, and we got there late.

questions.stem: What can we learn about Leo at the lantern show?
options: He was afraid of the dark.
He wanted to go home early.
He did not like the lanterns.
questions.explain: Leo 安靜不下來、跑來跑去、對每盞燈籠大叫，可推知他非常興奮，故選 (D)。他對每盞燈籠都有反應，並不是不喜歡，(C) 不對。
questions.evidence: He ran from one side to the other and shouted at every lantern.

questions.stem: According to the writer's grandmother, what did people use lanterns for long ago?
options: To show the way on dark roads
To cook food by the lake
questions.explain: 第二段最後一句說以前的人提燈籠在黑暗的路上帶路，故選 (A)。文末「讓黑夜變溫暖」是作者的感想，不是說燈籠用來取暖，(B) 不對。
questions.evidence: My grandmother told us that long ago, people carried lanterns to lead the way on dark roads.

questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?
options: How to make a lantern by hand
Why the roads are busy on holidays
A family's night at a lantern show
A kid who got lost by a lake
questions.explain: 全文描述作者一家在元宵節晚上去湖邊看燈會的經過與感想，故選 (C)。手工做燈籠只是旁人提到的一句話，(A) 太細。
questions.evidence: Last Saturday was the Lantern Festival, so my family went to a lantern show by a large lake near our town.

vocab.stem: Hurry up, or we will be ______ for school again.
vocab.explain: be late for school 是「上學遲到」，前面說快一點，故選 late。large（大的）、last（最後的）不合語意；lazy（懶惰的）不和 for school 這樣搭配。

vocab.stem: I want to ______ how to swim this summer, so I will take lessons.
vocab.explain: learn how to swim 是「學游泳」，後面說要去上課，故選 learn。lead（帶領）、lay（放置）、keep（保持）都不能接 how to swim。

title: My Summer at the Ice Shop
paragraphs: This summer, I helped at my uncle's ice shop in a [[local|J-0825]] market. He is the [[manager|J-0848]], and on my first day he gave me a [[list|J-0820]] of jobs: wash the [[fruit|J-0581]], [[clean|J-0281]] the tables, and never be late.

The most popular thing we sell is [[mango|J-0849]] ice. Every afternoon, there is a [[long|J-0827]] [[line|J-0816]] outside the shop. My job is to cut the mangoes, and my uncle makes the ice with an old [[machine|J-0836]]. The machine is very [[loud|J-0830]], so we have to shout to each other. Some people also ask for a little [[lemon|J-0801]] on top.

One hot day, the shop was so [[busy|J-0204]] that I forgot to eat [[lunch|J-0835]]. I felt tired and a little [[mad|J-0837]]. Then a little girl said to me, "Thank you! This is the best ice in my whole [[life|J-0811]]!" Her good [[manners|J-0850]] made me smile again. At that moment, I felt [[lucky|J-0834]] to have this summer job.
zh: 這個暑假，我在舅舅位於當地市場的冰店幫忙。他是店長，第一天就給我一張工作清單：洗水果、擦桌子，而且絕對不能遲到。
我們賣得最好的是芒果冰。每天下午，店外都排著長長的隊伍。我的工作是切芒果，舅舅則用一台舊機器做冰。那台機器非常吵，所以我們得對彼此大喊。有些人還會要求在上面加一點檸檬。
有一天天氣很熱，店裡忙到我忘了吃午餐。我覺得又累又有點生氣。這時一個小女孩對我說：「謝謝你！這是我這輩子吃過最好吃的冰！」她這麼有禮貌，讓我又露出了笑容。那一刻，我覺得能有這份暑期工作真幸運。

questions.stem: Why do the writer and the uncle have to shout to each other?
options: The ice machine is very loud.
There are too many people talking.
questions.explain: 第二段說那台機器很吵，所以要大喊，故選 (A)。店外雖然大排長龍，但文中沒說是人聲太吵，(B) 不對。
questions.evidence: The machine is very loud, so we have to shout to each other.

questions.stem: The word "mad" in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to ______.
questions.explain: 作者又忙又沒吃午餐，覺得累而且有點 mad，這裡是「生氣、不高興」，與 angry 最接近，故選 (C)。他確實沒吃午餐，但 mad 不是「餓」的意思，(A) 不對。
questions.evidence: I felt tired and a little mad.

questions.stem: What made the writer feel better on the busy day?
options: The writer's uncle let the writer go home early.
The writer finally ate a big lunch.
The writer got some money from the manager.
A little girl thanked the writer kindly.
questions.explain: 小女孩有禮貌地道謝，讓作者重新笑出來，故選 (D)。文中只說他忘了吃午餐，沒有說後來吃了大餐，(B) 不對。
questions.evidence: Her good manners made me smile again.

questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?
options: How to make mango ice at home
A student's summer job at an ice shop
questions.explain: 全文描述作者暑假在舅舅冰店打工的工作內容與心情，故選 (B)。小女孩只出現在最後一段，(D) 不是主旨。
questions.evidence: This summer, I helped at my uncle's ice shop in a local market.

vocab.stem: Ken was very ______. He found his lost key under the bed.
vocab.explain: 找回遺失的鑰匙，表示他很「幸運」，故選 lucky。lonely（寂寞的）、loud（大聲的）、low（低的）都和找到鑰匙無關。

vocab.stem: It is twelve o'clock. Let's go and have ______ together.
vocab.explain: 中午十二點一起去吃「午餐」，have lunch 最通順，故選 lunch。lemon（檸檬）、magic（魔術）、mail（郵件）都不合語意。

title: Ben's Wrong-Way Monday
paragraphs: On [[Monday|J-0898]] morning, Ben had a club [[meeting|J-0873]] at eight. His [[alarm|J-0035]] did not ring because he forgot to set it the night before. He woke up at seven thirty, quickly looked at himself in the [[mirror|J-0891]], and ran out without breakfast.

He took the [[metro|J-0880]] across the [[city|J-0275]]. The train was warm and quiet, and Ben was very tired because he had studied [[math|J-0862]] until [[midnight|J-0882]]. For a [[moment|J-0897]], he closed his eyes. When he opened them, he saw the [[map|J-0852]] on the wall and knew he had made a big [[mistake|J-0893]]. He had [[missed|J-0892]] his stop and gone five stations too far!

Ben took a train back and ran the last few hundred [[meters|J-0879]] to school. He was twenty [[minutes|J-0890]] late, so he said sorry to the other club [[members|J-0874]]. The leader just laughed and said, "Never [[mind|J-0887]]. We all make mistakes." Ben learned his lesson: go to bed early, and always set the alarm!
zh: 星期一早上，Ben 八點要開社團會議。他的鬧鐘沒有響，因為他前一晚忘了設定。他七點半才醒來，匆匆照了一下鏡子，連早餐都沒吃就衝出門。
他搭捷運穿過市區。車廂裡又暖又安靜，而 Ben 非常累，因為他念數學念到半夜。他閉上眼睛一下下。等他再睜開眼，看到牆上的路線圖，就知道自己犯了大錯。他已經坐過站整整五站了！
Ben 搭車折回，最後幾百公尺用跑的衝到學校。他遲到了二十分鐘，所以向其他社員道歉。社長只是笑著說：「沒關係，大家都會犯錯。」Ben 學到了教訓：要早點睡，而且一定要設鬧鐘！

questions.stem: Why didn't Ben's alarm ring on Monday morning?
options: He put it in the wrong room.
He forgot to set it the night before.
questions.explain: 第一段說他前一晚忘了設鬧鐘，故選 (D)。文中沒有說鬧鐘壞掉，(A) 是常見的錯誤聯想。
questions.evidence: His alarm did not ring because he forgot to set it the night before.

questions.stem: Why was Ben so tired on the train?
options: He ran all the way to the station.
He had a long club meeting.
questions.explain: 第二段說他很累是因為念數學念到半夜，故選 (B)。他確實沒吃早餐，但文中說累的原因是熬夜念書，(C) 不對。
questions.evidence: The train was warm and quiet, and Ben was very tired because he had studied math until midnight.

questions.stem: In paragraph 3, the leader says "Never mind." What does he mean?
options: It's OK. Don't worry about it.
questions.explain: 社長笑著說 Never mind，後面接「大家都會犯錯」，意思是「沒關係，別在意」，故選 (A)。社長是笑著安慰他，不是要他別再來，(B) 不對。
questions.evidence: We all make mistakes.

questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?
options: How to take the metro in a big city
Why math is hard for Ben
Ben's bad morning and the lesson he learned
A club leader who is always late
questions.explain: 全文寫 Ben 星期一早上睡過頭、坐過站、開會遲到，最後學到教訓，故選 (C)。遲到的是 Ben 不是社長，(D) 不對。
questions.evidence: Ben learned his lesson: go to bed early, and always set the alarm!

vocab.stem: Sorry, I took your umbrella by ______. I thought it was mine.
vocab.explain: by mistake 是「不小心、弄錯」，後面說以為那是自己的傘，故選 mistake。money、model、milk 都不能和 by 這樣搭配。

vocab.stem: Please wait a ______. I'll be right back.
vocab.explain: wait a minute 是「等一下」，後面說馬上回來，故選 minute。mile（英里）、million（百萬）、mirror（鏡子）都不合語意。

title: A Night Under the Stars
paragraphs: Last [[month|J-0901]], our nature club went to a [[national|J-0929]] park in the [[mountains|J-0909]]. We planned to [[camp|J-0218]] there for one night. Before the trip, our teacher told us that it was [[necessary|J-0935]] to bring warm clothes, because the nights are cold up there.

On the first [[morning|J-0905]], we began to [[hike|J-0678]] through a [[forest|J-0555]]. It had rained the day before, so the path was full of [[mud|J-0920]]. Our shoes became heavy and dirty, but everyone was in a good mood. We saw many kinds of [[birds|J-0153]], and a small [[mouse|J-0910]] ran across the path. The trees, the air, and the water all felt clean and [[natural|J-0930]].

At night, we lay on the grass and looked at the [[moon|J-0902]]. My friend Mia was [[nervous|J-0943]] about sleeping outside at first, but soon she [[nearly|J-0934]] fell asleep under the stars. Our teacher said, "In the city, we [[never|J-0945]] see so many stars. [[Nature|J-0931]] is the best teacher." I will remember this trip for a long time.
zh: 上個月，我們自然社到山上的一座國家公園。我們打算在那裡露營一晚。出發前，老師告訴我們一定要帶保暖的衣服，因為山上的夜晚很冷。
第一天早上，我們開始穿越森林健行。前一天下過雨，所以步道上滿是泥巴。我們的鞋子變得又重又髒，但大家心情都很好。我們看到很多種鳥，還有一隻小老鼠從步道上跑過去。樹木、空氣和水，全都感覺乾淨又自然。
晚上，我們躺在草地上看月亮。我的朋友 Mia 一開始對睡在戶外感到緊張，但沒多久她就在星空下快要睡著了。老師說：「在城市裡，我們從來看不到這麼多星星。大自然是最好的老師。」我會把這趟旅行記很久很久。

questions.stem: Why did the teacher tell the students to bring warm clothes?
options: They would swim in a cold river.
It was going to rain all day.
The nights in the mountains are cold.
The park did not have any houses.
questions.explain: 第一段說要帶保暖衣服，因為山上夜晚很冷，故選 (C)。下雨是前一天的事，和帶保暖衣物的理由無關，(B) 不對。
questions.evidence: Before the trip, our teacher told us that it was necessary to bring warm clothes, because the nights are cold up there.

questions.stem: Why was the path full of mud?
options: It had rained the day before.
questions.explain: 第二段說前一天下過雨，所以步道滿是泥巴，故選 (A)。文中提到水很乾淨，但沒說有河流穿過步道，(C) 不對。
questions.evidence: It had rained the day before, so the path was full of mud.

questions.stem: How did Mia most likely feel at the end of the night?
questions.explain: Mia 一開始緊張，但後來在星空下快要睡著，可推知她已經放鬆、平靜下來，故選 (D)。害怕是她一開始的心情，不是最後的感受，(A) 不對。
questions.evidence: My friend Mia was nervous about sleeping outside at first, but soon she nearly fell asleep under the stars.

questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?
options: How to choose good hiking shoes
A nature club's camping trip in the mountains
Why city people cannot see stars
The animals that live in a forest
questions.explain: 全文記錄自然社到國家公園露營、健行、看星星的經過與感想，故選 (B)。城市看不到星星只是老師的一句話，(C) 太細。
questions.evidence: Last month, our nature club went to a national park in the mountains.

vocab.stem: Amy felt ______ before her first speech, and her hands were cold.
vocab.explain: 第一次演講前手都冰冷，表示她很「緊張」，故選 nervous。national（國家的）、natural（自然的）、naughty（頑皮的）都不合語意。

vocab.stem: Water is ______ for all living things. We cannot live without it.
vocab.explain: 沒有水就無法生存，表示水是「必要的」，故選 necessary。next（下一個）、near（附近的）、nervous（緊張的）都不合語意。

title: A Visit to the Nurse
paragraphs: One [[November|J-0974]] morning, Lisa felt terrible in class. Her [[nose|J-0967]] was running, and her head hurt. At [[noon|J-0964]], she could not eat her [[noodles|J-0963]]. Her friend Ken [[noticed|J-0972]] that her face was very red, so he took her to the health [[office|J-0985]].

The school [[nurse|J-0977]], Ms. Lin, checked Lisa and said, "You have a [[fever|J-0519]]. It is not serious, but you should go home and see a [[doctor|J-0400]]." Then she called Lisa's mother. Lisa [[nodded|J-0959]] and lay down on the bed. The room was quiet, not [[noisy|J-0961]] like her classroom, so she soon fell asleep.

Lisa stayed home for two days. She slept a lot and did not even [[open|J-0996]] her [[notebook|J-0970]]. Before she left school, Ms. Lin had given her a [[note|J-0969]] with three simple rules: wash your hands [[often|J-0987]], go to bed early, and drink a lot of water. Now Lisa is [[healthy|J-0660]] again, and she keeps the note on her desk.
zh: 十一月的某個早上，Lisa 在課堂上覺得很不舒服。她流鼻水，頭也很痛。中午時，她連麵都吃不下。她的朋友 Ken 注意到她的臉很紅，就帶她去健康中心。
學校護理師林老師幫 Lisa 檢查後說：「你發燒了。不算嚴重，但你應該回家看醫生。」接著她打電話給 Lisa 的媽媽。Lisa 點點頭，躺到床上。房間很安靜，不像她的教室那麼吵，所以她很快就睡著了。
Lisa 在家休息了兩天。她睡了很多，連筆記本都沒打開。離開學校前，林老師給了她一張紙條，上面寫著三條簡單的規則：常洗手、早點睡、多喝水。現在 Lisa 又恢復健康了，她把那張紙條放在書桌上。

questions.stem: Who took Lisa to the health office?
questions.explain: 第一段說朋友 Ken 注意到她臉很紅，就帶她去健康中心，故選 (B)。林老師是在健康中心幫她檢查的護理師，不是帶她去的人，(D) 不對。
questions.evidence: Her friend Ken noticed that her face was very red, so he took her to the health office.

questions.stem: In paragraph 2, "Lisa nodded." What did she do?
options: She shook her head to say no.
She cried because she was sick.
She moved her head up and down to say yes.
questions.explain: nod 是「點頭」，Lisa 聽了護理師的話後點頭表示同意，故選 (D)。shake one's head 是「搖頭」，意思相反，(A) 不對。
questions.evidence: Lisa nodded and lay down on the bed.

questions.stem: Which of these is one of Ms. Lin's rules?
questions.explain: 第三段列出三條規則：常洗手、早點睡、多喝水，故選 (A)。安靜的房間是健康中心的描述，不是規則，(C) 不對。
questions.evidence: Before she left school, Ms. Lin had given her a note with three simple rules: wash your hands often, go to bed early, and drink a lot of water.

questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?
options: How to become a school nurse
Why students should not eat noodles
A sick student who gets help and gets well
questions.explain: 全文寫 Lisa 生病、到健康中心求助、回家休息後康復的經過，故選 (C)。吵鬧的教室只是用來對比健康中心的安靜，(D) 不是主旨。
questions.evidence: Now Lisa is healthy again, and she keeps the note on her desk.

vocab.stem: My father works in an ______ near Taipei Station. He takes the MRT there every day.
vocab.explain: 爸爸在台北車站附近的「辦公室」上班，故選 office。ocean（海洋）、oil（油）、order（命令、訂單）都不是上班的地方。

vocab.stem: Mia ______ goes jogging. She runs four times a week.
vocab.explain: 一週跑四次，表示她「常常」去慢跑，故選 often。open（打開）、old（老的）、other（其他的）都不能放在動詞 goes 前面修飾頻率。

title: Bobo Joins the Family
paragraphs: Last month, my [[parents|J-1024]] finally let me have a [[pet|J-1047]]. We got a [[dog|J-0402]] named Bobo from an [[animal|J-0058]] shelter. His last [[owner|J-1009]] gave him too much food, so he was a little [[overweight|J-1006]].

The doctor said Bobo needed more exercise. Now I walk him in the [[park|J-1025]] every evening after school. At first, he got tired after ten minutes and just sat down. I had to be [[patient|J-1032]] with him. Little by little, he is walking longer and longer. I also [[feed|J-0515]] him at the same times every day, and nobody gives him our food anymore.

Taking [[care|J-0227]] of a pet is not easy. It takes time and money. I [[pay|J-1034]] for his toys with [[part|J-1027]] of my pocket money. But Bobo is a great [[partner|J-1028]]. He sits next to me when I do homework, and our home feels more [[peaceful|J-1037]] with him. I take a [[photo|J-1049]] of him every day with my [[phone|J-1048]]. [[Perhaps|J-1043]] next year, he will be strong enough to jog with me!
zh: 上個月，我爸媽終於答應讓我養寵物。我們從動物收容所帶回一隻叫 Bobo 的狗。牠的前主人給牠吃太多，所以牠有點過重。
獸醫說 Bobo 需要多運動。現在我每天放學後的傍晚都帶牠去公園散步。一開始，牠走十分鐘就累了，直接坐下來。我必須對牠很有耐心。慢慢地，牠能走得越來越久。我也每天在固定的時間餵牠，而且家裡再也沒有人拿我們的食物給牠吃。
照顧寵物並不容易，要花時間也要花錢。我用一部分的零用錢幫牠買玩具。不過 Bobo 是很棒的夥伴。我寫功課時牠會坐在我旁邊，有牠在，家裡感覺更平靜了。我每天都用手機幫牠拍一張照片。也許明年牠就壯到可以跟我一起慢跑了！

questions.stem: Why was Bobo a little overweight?
options: He did not like to walk.
He ate the writer's pocket money.
He slept all day in the park.
His last owner gave him too much food.
questions.explain: 第一段說牠的前主人給牠吃太多，所以有點過重，故選 (D)。牠一開始走沒多久就累，是過重的結果，不是文中說的原因，(A) 不對。
questions.evidence: His last owner gave him too much food, so he was a little overweight.

questions.stem: The word "patient" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to ______.
questions.explain: Bobo 走十分鐘就累，作者必須慢慢等牠進步，這裡 patient 是「有耐心的」，故選 (A)。patient 當名詞是「病人」，但這裡是 be patient with，不是「生病」，(B) 不對。
questions.evidence: I had to be patient with him.

questions.stem: How does the writer feel about Bobo?
options: He thinks Bobo costs too much money.
He wants to give Bobo back to the shelter.
He is happy to have Bobo at home.
He is tired of walking Bobo every day.
questions.explain: 作者說 Bobo 是很棒的夥伴、家裡因牠更平靜，還每天幫牠拍照，可見他很高興有 Bobo，故選 (C)。作者雖然提到養寵物要花錢，但後面用 But 轉折，重點是牠的好，(A) 不對。
questions.evidence: But Bobo is a great partner.

questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?
options: How to choose a dog at a shelter
A student taking care of his new dog
Why parents do not like pets
How to take good photos with a phone
questions.explain: 全文寫作者領養 Bobo 後帶牠運動、餵食、照顧牠的經過與心得，故選 (B)。拍照只是最後一段的一個細節，(D) 不是主旨。
questions.evidence: Taking care of a pet is not easy.

vocab.stem: How much did you ______ for this pair of shoes?
vocab.explain: pay for 是「為……付錢」，問鞋子花了多少錢，故選 pay。pass（經過）、paint（油漆）、pack（打包）都不合語意。

vocab.stem: Let's take a ______ in front of the lake to remember this trip.
vocab.explain: take a photo 是「拍照」，在湖前拍照留念，故選 photo。pencil（鉛筆）、period（期間）、pattern（圖案）都不合語意。

title: Kevin and the Swim Team
paragraphs: Kevin [[joined|J-0748]] the school swim team last month. At first, he was a [[poor|J-1085]] swimmer. He could only swim slowly in the [[pool|J-1084]], and he often stopped to rest. But he did not give up. He went to [[practice|J-1099]] every morning before class, and he did extra [[exercise|J-0488]] at home.

Their coach, Ms. Lin, had a new [[plan|J-1064]] for the team. She gave each [[player|J-1071]] a different [[position|J-1091]] in the team race. Kevin was the first swimmer. "Is it [[possible|J-1092]] for me to swim that fast?" he asked. "Yes," Ms. Lin said. "Your legs have a lot of [[power|J-1098]]. Just be [[careful|J-0228]] at the start."

Last Saturday, the team won second [[place|J-1063]] in a city race. Ms. Lin [[praised|J-1100]] Kevin in front of everyone, and he was very [[pleased|J-1074]]. After the race, the team shared a big [[pizza|J-1062]]. Kevin learned an important [[point|J-1079]] that day: practice really makes a difference.
zh: Kevin 上個月加入了學校游泳隊。一開始，他游得很差。他在泳池裡只能慢慢地游，而且常常停下來休息。但是他沒有放棄。他每天早上課前都去練習，回家後也做額外的運動。
他們的教練林老師為隊伍訂了新計畫。她在團體接力賽中給每位選手不同的位置。Kevin 是第一棒。「我有可能游得那麼快嗎？」他問。「可以的，」林老師說，「你的腿很有力量。只要在出發時小心一點就好。」
上週六，游泳隊在一場市賽中得到第二名。林老師在大家面前稱讚 Kevin，他非常高興。比賽結束後，全隊一起分享一個大披薩。Kevin 那天學到了一個重要的道理：練習真的會帶來改變。

questions.stem: What did Kevin do to become a better swimmer?
options: He stopped swimming for a month.
He watched swimming videos at night.
He practiced every morning and exercised at home.
He asked another player to swim for him.
questions.explain: 第一段說他每天早上課前去練習，回家也做額外運動，故選 (C)。(A) 文中說他沒有放棄，並沒有停止游泳。
questions.evidence: He went to practice every morning before class, and he did extra exercise at home.

questions.stem: The word "power" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to ______.
questions.explain: 教練說 Kevin 的腿很有 power，指「力量」，與 strength 最接近，故選 (A)。power 雖也有「權力」的意思，但這裡指腿的力量，與錢 (B) 無關。
questions.evidence: Your legs have a lot of power.

questions.stem: Why did Kevin ask, "Is it possible for me to swim that fast?"
options: He wanted to change his position.
He was not sure he was good enough.
He thought the race was too easy.
He did not like the coach's plan.
questions.explain: Kevin 剛開始游得不好，被排第一棒時問自己是否做得到，可推論他對自己沒信心，故選 (B)。(C) 他並不覺得比賽太簡單，正好相反。
questions.evidence: "Is it possible for me to swim that fast?" he asked.

questions.stem: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: Pizza is the best food after a race.
A coach should praise every player.
Swimming pools are popular in summer.
Hard practice can help a weak swimmer improve.
questions.explain: 全文寫 Kevin 從游得很差到勤練後得名，最後點出練習會帶來改變，故選 (D)。(A) 披薩只是賽後的小細節，不是重點。
questions.evidence: Kevin learned an important point that day: practice really makes a difference.

vocab.stem: The teacher ______ Leo for his clean and careful homework, and Leo smiled.
vocab.explain: 老師因 Leo 的作業乾淨又仔細而「稱讚」他，Leo 才會笑，故選 praised。missed（錯過）、broke（打破）、washed（洗）都不合句意。

vocab.stem: Is it ______ to finish this big pizza in five minutes? I don't think anyone can do it.
vocab.explain: 後句說沒人做得到，前句問五分鐘吃完是否「可能」，故選 possible。angry（生氣的）、hungry（餓的）、rich（有錢的）放進 Is it ___ to... 句型都不通。

title: A Rainy Day Surprise
paragraphs: Thursday. This morning the sky was gray, and the radio said it would [[probably|J-1114]] [[rain|J-1141]]. I put my [[raincoat|J-1143]] in my bag. We had a math [[quiz|J-1135]] today, so I tried to [[prepare|J-1102]] for it on the bus. One question was a hard [[problem|J-1115]], and I spent ten minutes on it.

It was a [[rainy|J-1144]] [[afternoon|J-0024]], but my friend Mia wanted to go to the [[library|J-0808]] after school. The library was [[quiet|J-1133]], and we read for an hour. When we came out, the rain had stopped. Mia [[pulled|J-1121]] my arm and said, "Look up!" There was a big [[rainbow|J-1142]] over the school.

I took a [[quick|J-1132]] photo of it with my phone. Later, I found out that I did well on the quiz, so I am [[proud|J-1119]] of myself. I would [[rather|J-1148]] have sunny days, but today a rainy day gave me two nice surprises.
zh: 星期四。今天早上天空灰灰的，收音機說可能會下雨。我把雨衣放進書包。我們今天有數學小考，所以我在公車上努力準備。其中一題是很難的問題，我花了十分鐘在上面。
那是個下雨的午後，但是我的朋友 Mia 放學後想去圖書館。圖書館很安靜，我們讀了一個小時的書。出來的時候，雨已經停了。Mia 拉著我的手臂說：「抬頭看！」學校上方有一道大彩虹。
我用手機很快地拍了一張照片。後來，我發現小考考得很好，所以我為自己感到驕傲。我寧願是晴天，但今天這個雨天給了我兩個美好的驚喜。

questions.stem: What did the writer do on the bus?
options: The writer took a photo of the sky.
The writer got ready for the math quiz.
questions.explain: 第一段說因為今天有數學小考，作者在公車上努力準備，故選 (D)。(C) 拍照是放學後看到彩虹時的事，不是在公車上。
questions.evidence: We had a math quiz today, so I tried to prepare for it on the bus.

questions.stem: In paragraph 3, what does "it" in "I took a quick photo of it" refer to?
questions.explain: 前一句提到學校上方有一道大彩虹，作者接著拍下它，所以 it 指彩虹，故選 (A)。(B) 圖書館是他們剛離開的地方，不是拍照的對象。
questions.evidence: There was a big rainbow over the school.

questions.stem: What are the "two nice surprises" in paragraph 3?
options: A new phone and a sunny day.
A rainbow and a good quiz result.
A free raincoat and a new book.
A quiet bus and an easy question.
questions.explain: 作者那天看到彩虹，又發現小考考得好，這就是兩個驚喜，故選 (B)。(D) 文中說有一題很難，並不是簡單的題目。
questions.evidence: Later, I found out that I did well on the quiz, so I am proud of myself.

questions.stem: What is the diary mainly about?
options: How to prepare for a math quiz.
Why the library is a good place to study.
A rainy day that ended in a happy way.
Why the writer does not like rain.
questions.explain: 日記記錄一個下雨天，最後看到彩虹、小考也考好，結局很開心，故選 (C)。(D) 作者雖然寧願晴天，但全文重點是雨天帶來驚喜，不是討厭下雨。
questions.evidence: I would rather have sunny days, but today a rainy day gave me two nice surprises.

vocab.stem: Please be ______ in the classroom. Some students are taking a test.
vocab.explain: 有同學在考試，所以要請大家「安靜」，故選 quiet。loud（大聲的）意思相反，hungry、late 也不合句意。

vocab.stem: Tom's dog was too heavy, so Tom ______ it out of the water with a rope.
vocab.explain: 用繩子把狗從水裡「拉」出來，故選 pulled。sang（唱）、cried（哭）、wrote（寫）都無法搭配 out of the water with a rope。

title: The Robot That Fell Over
paragraphs: Every Friday, Ben goes to the robot club at his school. This term, the club is building a small [[robot|J-1178]] that can pick up trash. Ben's [[role|J-1180]] is to write the [[computer|J-0310]] [[program|J-1118]], and his friend Amy makes the body. They use a [[ruler|J-1194]] to check the size of every part.

Last week, the robot was finally [[ready|J-1151]] for a test. They put it on the [[road|J-1177]] next to the school, but it did not move in a straight line. It hit a [[rock|J-1179]] and fell over. Amy had to [[repair|J-1161]] one of its [[round|J-1189]] wheels. Ben felt [[sad|J-1196]], but their teacher said, "Don't worry. Take a [[rest|J-1165]] and try again."

The club has one important [[rule|J-1193]]: [[safety|J-1198]] first. Everyone must wear gloves when they use tools. This week, the [[result|J-1168]] of the test was much better. The robot picked up ten bottles. Ben still [[remembers|J-1160]] the teacher's words: "Every [[mistake|J-0893]] helps us learn."
zh: 每個星期五，Ben 都會去學校的機器人社。這學期，社團正在做一台會撿垃圾的小機器人。Ben 的角色是寫電腦程式，他的朋友 Amy 負責做機身。他們用尺檢查每個零件的大小。
上週，機器人終於準備好要測試了。他們把它放在學校旁邊的路上，但它沒辦法走直線。它撞到一塊石頭就倒了。Amy 必須修理它的一個圓形輪子。Ben 很難過，但老師說：「別擔心。休息一下再試一次。」
社團有一條重要的規則：安全第一。每個人使用工具時都必須戴手套。這週，測試的結果好多了。機器人撿起了十個瓶子。Ben 仍然記得老師的話：「每個錯誤都能幫助我們學習。」

questions.stem: What is Ben's job in the robot club?
options: He makes the body of the robot.
He buys the tools for the club.
questions.explain: 第一段說 Ben 的角色是寫電腦程式，故選 (B)。(A) 做機身的是 Amy，不是 Ben。
questions.evidence: Ben's role is to write the computer program, and his friend Amy makes the body.

questions.stem: What happened during the first test?
options: The robot hit a rock and fell over.
The robot picked up ten bottles.
The robot ran into the school.
questions.explain: 第二段說第一次測試時機器人撞到石頭倒下，故選 (A)。(B) 撿起十個瓶子是這週第二次測試的結果。
questions.evidence: It hit a rock and fell over.

questions.stem: The word "repair" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to ______.
questions.explain: 輪子壞了，Amy 必須 repair 它，意思是「修理」，與 fix 相同，故選 (C)。(D) throw 是「丟」，把輪子丟掉不合文意。
questions.evidence: Amy had to repair one of its round wheels.

questions.stem: What lesson does the passage mainly teach?
options: Robots are too hard for students.
Students should not work on the road.
Only smart people can join a robot club.
We can learn from mistakes and do better.
questions.explain: 機器人第一次失敗，修理後第二次成功，最後用老師的話點出錯誤能幫助學習，故選 (D)。(A) 學生最後做成功了，與文意相反。
questions.evidence: Ben still remembers the teacher's words: "Every mistake helps us learn."

vocab.stem: Dinner is ______. Please wash your hands and come to the table.
vocab.explain: 叫大家洗手上桌，表示晚餐「準備好了」，故選 ready。rich（有錢的）、rare（稀有的）、round（圓的）都不合句意。

vocab.stem: In our school, the ______ is that students cannot use phones in class.
vocab.explain: 上課不能用手機是學校的「規定」，故選 rule。roof（屋頂）、rope（繩子）、rose（玫瑰）拼字相近但意思不對。

title: Our Class Sale for the Dogs
paragraphs: Dear classmates, our class will hold a [[sale|J-1201]] on [[Saturday|J-1208]], [[September|J-1240]] 20, to [[raise|J-1145]] money for a dog shelter. We will [[sell|J-1235]] cookies, [[sandwiches|J-1206]], and cold drinks. We will also have a ball game. If your [[score|J-1216]] is over 80, you will get a [[free|J-0567]] cookie!

Please [[select|J-1233]] one job from the list on the classroom door. [[Several|J-1249]] students will make the food at home, and others will [[serve|J-1243]] the customers at the table. We also need two people to make an ad. We will show it on the big [[screen|J-1217]] in the school hall.

This is a [[serious|J-1241]] job, not just a party. Every dollar we [[save|J-1209]] for the dogs will help them stay warm and find a new home. Please [[send|J-1236]] me a message by Wednesday. Thank you! Lisa, class leader
zh: 親愛的同學們，我們班將在 9 月 20 日星期六舉辦義賣，為一間流浪狗收容所募款。我們會賣餅乾、三明治和冷飲。我們還會辦一個投球遊戲。如果你的分數超過 80 分，就能得到一塊免費的餅乾！
請從教室門上的清單中選一項工作。幾位同學會在家準備食物，其他同學則在攤位上服務客人。我們也需要兩個人製作廣告。我們會把它放在學校禮堂的大螢幕上。
這是一份認真的工作，不只是一場派對。我們為狗狗存下的每一塊錢，都能幫助牠們保暖並找到新家。請在星期三以前傳訊息給我。謝謝大家！班長 Lisa

questions.stem: Why is the class holding the sale?
options: To buy a new screen for the hall.
To have a party after the exam.
To raise money for a dog shelter.
To pay for a class trip.
questions.explain: 第一段說義賣是為了替狗狗收容所募款，故選 (C)。(B) 第三段特別說這不只是一場派對。
questions.evidence: Dear classmates, our class will hold a sale on Saturday, September 20, to raise money for a dog shelter.

questions.stem: How can a student get a free cookie?
options: By getting a score over 80 in the ball game.
By making an ad for the sale.
questions.explain: 第一段說投球遊戲分數超過 80 分就能得到免費餅乾，故選 (A)。(C) 傳訊息給 Lisa 是為了報名工作，與免費餅乾無關。
questions.evidence: If your score is over 80, you will get a free cookie!

questions.stem: The word "select" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to ______.
questions.explain: 從清單中 select 一項工作，意思是「挑選」，與 choose 相同，故選 (D)。(A) sell 拼字相近，但意思是「賣」。
questions.evidence: Please select one job from the list on the classroom door.

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of Lisa's message?
options: To tell classmates how to make cookies.
To ask classmates to help with the class sale.
To invite classmates to a birthday party.
To explain how to take care of dogs.
questions.explain: Lisa 說明義賣的時間、目的，並請同學選工作、回訊息，主要是請大家幫忙義賣，故選 (B)。(A) 文中只提到要賣餅乾，沒有教做法。
questions.evidence: Please select one job from the list on the classroom door.

vocab.stem: My uncle ______ fruit at the night market. His apples are sweet and cheap.
vocab.explain: 叔叔在夜市「賣」水果，後句提到蘋果又甜又便宜，故選 sells。sleeps（睡）、swims（游泳）、sits（坐）都無法接 fruit。

vocab.stem: Don't laugh. This is a ______ problem, and we need to talk about it now.
vocab.explain: 要大家別笑、現在就得談，表示問題很「嚴重」，故選 serious。funny（好笑的）、silly（愚蠢的）與「別笑」矛盾。

title: Mia at Grandpa's Shop
paragraphs: Every Sunday, Mia helps at her grandpa's small [[shop|J-1264]] near the [[market|J-0854]]. He sells [[simple|J-1285]] things like socks, [[shirts|J-1261]], and [[shorts|J-1268]]. Mia was [[shy|J-1275]], so at first she was [[silent|J-1281]] when customers came in. She only looked at her phone.

Grandpa [[showed|J-1272]] her how to say hello to people with a smile. "Talking to people is a [[skill|J-1297]]," he said. "You can learn it, just like riding a bike." He also asked her to [[share|J-1253]] her ideas. Mia said they could put the new shirts on a [[shelf|J-1258]] near the door, so people could see them from the street.

Now Mia is not [[similar|J-1284]] to the quiet girl she was last year. She talks with every customer and even [[sings|J-1287]] along to the old songs on Grandpa's [[radio|J-1138]]. [[Since|J-1286]] she started helping, the shop has sold more shirts than before. Grandpa is very [[proud|J-1119]] of her.
zh: 每個星期天，Mia 都會到爺爺在市場附近的小店幫忙。爺爺賣一些簡單的東西，像是襪子、襯衫和短褲。Mia 原本很害羞，所以一開始客人進來時，她都不說話，只是看著手機。
爺爺教她如何帶著微笑向人打招呼。「和人說話是一種技能，」他說，「你學得會的，就像學騎腳踏車一樣。」他也請她分享自己的想法。Mia 說可以把新襯衫放在門邊的架子上，這樣人們從街上就看得到。
現在的 Mia 和去年那個安靜的女孩不一樣了。她會和每位客人聊天，甚至跟著爺爺收音機裡的老歌一起唱。自從她開始幫忙以來，店裡賣出的襯衫比以前更多。爺爺非常以她為傲。

questions.stem: What did Mia do when customers came in at first?
options: She stayed silent and looked at her phone.
She showed them the new shirts.
She called her grandpa for help.
questions.explain: 第一段說 Mia 很害羞，一開始客人進來時她不說話，只看手機，故選 (B)。(A) 跟著唱歌是她後來改變之後的事。
questions.evidence: She only looked at her phone.

questions.stem: Why did Grandpa say talking to people is "just like riding a bike"?
options: He wanted Mia to ride a bike to the shop.
He thought Mia should sell bikes.
He meant Mia could learn it with practice.
questions.explain: 爺爺說和人說話是一種技能，可以像騎腳踏車一樣學會，意思是多練習就會，故選 (C)。(A) 爺爺只是打比方，並不是真的要她騎車。
questions.evidence: "You can learn it, just like riding a bike."

questions.stem: What was Mia's idea for the shop?
options: Putting the new shirts on a shelf near the door.
Playing new songs on the radio.
questions.explain: 第二段說 Mia 提議把新襯衫放在門邊的架子上，讓街上的人看得到，故選 (A)。(C) 收音機播的是爺爺的老歌，不是她的點子。
questions.evidence: Mia said they could put the new shirts on a shelf near the door, so people could see them from the street.

questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?
options: How to sell more socks at a market.
Why old songs are better than new ones.
Why Grandpa wants to close his shop.
How a shy girl changes by helping at a shop.
questions.explain: 全文寫害羞的 Mia 在爺爺店裡幫忙，學會與人交談而改變，故選 (D)。(A) 店裡賣更多的是襯衫，而且銷售只是結果，不是重點。
questions.evidence: Now Mia is not similar to the quiet girl she was last year.

vocab.stem: Cooking is a useful ______. If you learn it, you can make your own meals.
vocab.explain: 做菜是一項有用的「技能」，學會了就能自己煮飯，故選 skill。sky（天空）、size（尺寸）、side（旁邊）拼字相近但意思不對。

vocab.stem: Ken has a big piece of cake. He wants to ______ it with his little brother.
vocab.explain: Ken 有一大塊蛋糕，想和弟弟「分享」，故選 share。shout（大叫）、shut（關上）、shake（搖動）都不合句意。

title: Soup for a Sore Throat
paragraphs: Last week, Ken caught a [[cold|J-0298]]. He had a [[sore|J-1339]] throat, and he felt [[sleepy|J-1302]] all day. He wanted to drink [[soda|J-1324]] and eat cookies and other [[snacks|J-1312]], but his mother said no. "Those things will not help you get well," she said.

So she made him a bowl of hot chicken [[soup|J-1343]] with a lot of vegetables. It had a [[special|J-1350]] [[smell|J-1309]] that filled the whole house. His little sister Nina came in with a [[smile|J-1310]]. She brought him a big [[pillow|J-1058]] from the [[sofa|J-1325]] and said, "Get well soon, big brother!"

Ken stayed home and went to bed early. He learned that [[sometimes|J-1334]] the best [[medicine|J-0871]] is [[something|J-1333]] simple: good food, water, and a lot of [[sleep|J-1301]]. Three days later, he felt much better and played [[soccer|J-1320]] with his friends again. He thanked his mother for the soup.
zh: 上週，Ken 感冒了。他喉嚨痛，而且整天都很想睡。他想喝汽水、吃餅乾和其他零食，但媽媽說不行。「那些東西不會幫助你康復，」她說。
於是她煮了一碗加了很多蔬菜的熱雞湯給他。湯有一種特別的香味，飄滿了整間屋子。他的妹妹 Nina 帶著微笑走進來。她從沙發上拿了一個大枕頭給他，並說：「哥哥，早日康復！」
Ken 待在家裡，很早就上床睡覺。他學到，有時候最好的藥是很簡單的東西：好的食物、水，還有充足的睡眠。三天後，他覺得好多了，又和朋友們一起踢足球。他謝謝媽媽為他煮的湯。

questions.stem: What did Ken's mother make for him?
options: A bowl of hot chicken soup.
questions.explain: 第二段說媽媽煮了一碗加很多蔬菜的熱雞湯給他，故選 (D)。(A)(B) 汽水和餅乾是 Ken 想吃，但媽媽不讓他吃的東西。
questions.evidence: So she made him a bowl of hot chicken soup with a lot of vegetables.

questions.stem: In paragraph 1, what does "Those things" refer to?
questions.explain: 前一句提到 Ken 想喝汽水、吃零食，媽媽說那些東西不能幫他康復，所以指汽水和零食，故選 (A)。(C) 湯是媽媽後來為他煮的，正是對他有幫助的東西。
questions.evidence: "Those things will not help you get well," she said.

questions.stem: How did Nina probably feel about her brother?
options: She did not care about him.
She cared about him and wanted to help.
She wanted to play soccer with him.
questions.explain: Nina 帶著微笑拿枕頭給哥哥，還祝他早日康復，可見她很關心哥哥，故選 (C)。(D) 後來一起踢足球的是 Ken 的朋友，不是 Nina。
questions.evidence: She brought him a big pillow from the sofa and said, "Get well soon, big brother!"

questions.stem: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: Soda is good for a sore throat.
Simple things like good food and sleep can help us get well.
Children should play soccer every day.
questions.explain: Ken 靠熱湯、喝水和充足睡眠康復，文中直接點出最好的藥是簡單的東西，故選 (B)。(A) 媽媽說汽水不能幫助康復，與文意相反。
questions.evidence: He learned that sometimes the best medicine is something simple: good food, water, and a lot of sleep.

vocab.stem: The bread from that bakery has a wonderful ______. I can find the shop with my nose!
vocab.explain: 用鼻子就能找到店，表示麵包有很棒的「香味」，故選 smell。sound（聲音）、color（顏色）、shape（形狀）都不是用鼻子感覺的。

vocab.stem: I don't go to the movies often, but ______ I go with my cousins on Sunday.
vocab.explain: 前半句說不常去看電影，後半句用 but 表示「有時候」會去，故選 sometimes。always（總是）、never（從不）都和前後文矛盾。

title: A Storm in Taipei
paragraphs: Last [[summer|J-1397]], Leo and his [[cousin|J-0334]] Emma took a trip to Taipei. On the first day, it was [[sunny|J-1400]] and hot. They walked down a busy [[street|J-1382]], looked at the shops, and bought [[strawberry|J-1381]] ice cream.

In the afternoon, a [[sudden|J-1394]] [[storm|J-1376]] came. Heavy rain fell, and the wind was very [[strong|J-1384]]. They ran to the nearest [[subway|J-1390]] [[station|J-1367]], but they did not know which train to take. Then a [[stranger|J-1380]], an old woman with a [[kind|J-0765]] face, walked up to them. She [[suggested|J-1396]] that they [[stay|J-1368]] inside until the rain stopped. She also showed them the right train on the [[map|J-0852]].
That night, Leo wrote the [[story|J-1377]] in his notebook. "A big city can feel [[strange|J-1379]] when you are new there," he wrote, "but kind people can make it feel like home."
zh: 去年夏天，Leo 和他的表妹 Emma 去台北旅行。第一天天氣晴朗又炎熱。他們走在一條熱鬧的街上，逛逛商店，還買了草莓冰淇淋。
下午，一場暴風雨突然來了。大雨落下，風也非常強。他們跑進最近的捷運站，卻不知道該搭哪一班車。這時，一位面容和善的陌生老太太走向他們。她建議他們待在站內直到雨停。她也在地圖上告訴他們該搭哪一班車。
