那天晚上，Leo 把這件事寫在筆記本裡。「當你初來乍到時，大城市可能會讓人覺得很陌生，」他寫道，「但親切的人能讓它感覺像家一樣。」

questions.stem: What was the weather like on the morning of the first day?
questions.explain: 第一段說第一天晴朗又炎熱，故選 (A)。(B) 下雨是下午暴風雨來了之後的事，不是一開始的天氣。
questions.evidence: On the first day, it was sunny and hot.

questions.stem: How did the old woman help Leo and Emma?
options: She drove them to their hotel.
She told them to stay inside and showed them the right train.
questions.explain: 第二段說老太太建議他們待在站內等雨停，並在地圖上指出該搭的車，故選 (D)。(B) 文中沒有提到她開車載他們。
questions.evidence: She also showed them the right train on the map.

questions.stem: The word "sudden" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to ______.
questions.explain: 早上還是晴天，下午暴風雨卻突然來了，sudden 指「突然的、沒預料到的」，故選 (C)。(A) slow（緩慢的）與「突然」意思相反。
questions.evidence: In the afternoon, a sudden storm came.

questions.stem: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: Taipei has the best ice cream in Taiwan.
Kind people can make a strange city feel like home.
We should never travel in summer.
The subway in Taipei is hard to use.
questions.explain: Leo 在暴風雨中不知道該搭哪班車，受到陌生人幫助，最後寫下親切的人能讓陌生城市像家，故選 (B)。(D) 他們一時不知道搭哪班車，但這不是全文要表達的重點。
questions.evidence: "A big city can feel strange when you are new there," he wrote, "but kind people can make it feel like home."

vocab.stem: Lisa is very ______. She can carry two big boxes of books at the same time.
vocab.explain: 能同時搬兩大箱書，表示 Lisa 很「強壯」，故選 strong。sleepy（想睡的）、shy（害羞的）、sick（生病的）都和搬重物無關。

vocab.stem: My mom told me not to talk to ______ on the internet. I don't know who they really are.
vocab.explain: 後句說不知道對方真正是誰，表示是「陌生人」，故選 strangers。teachers、parents、classmates 都是認識的人。

title: Tea Time with Grandpa
paragraphs: My grandpa loves [[tea|J-1426]]. Every Sunday, he puts his old [[teapot|J-1430]] on the [[table|J-1416]] and calls me. "Come and sit down," he says. "Let me [[teach|J-1427]] you something." I am a [[teenager|J-1432]], and I usually want to play on my phone. But I always go, because his tea time is [[special|J-1350]].

Last Sunday, Grandpa [[told|J-1435]] me a [[story|J-1377]] about the teapot. Fifty years ago, he bought it near an old [[temple|J-1436]] in Tainan. Then he gave it to Grandma as a [[gift|J-0597]]. "She was the best tea [[teacher|J-1428]] in our town," he said with a smile. Grandma died ten years ago, and I could see a [[tear|J-1431]] in his eye.

Then he gave me a cup. The tea did not [[taste|J-1424]] [[sweet|J-1410]] at first, but after a moment, it was soft and nice. "Good tea [[takes|J-1420]] time," Grandpa said. "So does learning." I was [[surprised|J-1407]]. I never knew a cup of tea could teach me about life. Now I [[thank|J-1444]] him for every Sunday.
zh: 我爺爺很愛喝茶。每個星期天，他都會把他的舊茶壺放在桌上，然後叫我過去。「來，坐下，」他說，「我教你一點東西。」我是個青少年，平常只想滑手機。但我每次都會去，因為他的喝茶時光很特別。
上個星期天，爺爺跟我講了一個關於這個茶壺的故事。五十年前，他在台南一座老廟附近買了它，後來把它送給奶奶當禮物。「她是我們鎮上最厲害的泡茶老師，」他笑著說。奶奶十年前過世了，我看見他眼中有一滴淚。
接著他遞給我一杯茶。這茶一開始喝起來並不甜，但過了一會兒，變得溫潤又好喝。「好茶需要時間，」爺爺說，「學習也是。」我很驚訝，從來不知道一杯茶也能教我人生的道理。現在，我很感謝他給我的每一個星期天。

questions.stem: Where did Grandpa buy the teapot?
options: At a night market in Taipei.
Near an old temple in Tainan.
In a store in his town.
questions.explain: 第二段說爺爺五十年前在臺南一座老廟附近買了茶壺，故選 (B)。(D) 文中的「泡茶老師」指的是奶奶，茶壺不是向她買的，而是送給她的。
questions.evidence: Fifty years ago, he bought it near an old temple in Tainan.

questions.stem: In paragraph 2, who does "She" in "She was the best tea teacher in our town" refer to?
questions.explain: 前一句說爺爺把茶壺送給奶奶，接著爺爺說「她是鎮上最好的泡茶老師」，She 指奶奶，故選 (C)。(D) 文中沒有提到廟裡的女人。
questions.evidence: Then he gave it to Grandma as a gift.

questions.stem: What does Grandpa mean by "Good tea takes time. So does learning."?
options: Learning, like good tea, needs patience.
Students should drink tea when they study.
Making tea is harder than learning.
The writer should spend less time on tea.
questions.explain: 茶要過一會兒才好喝，爺爺說學習也一樣，意思是學習和好茶都需要時間與耐心，故選 (A)。(B) 只抓住「茶」和「學習」兩個字，並不是爺爺的意思。
questions.evidence: "Good tea takes time," Grandpa said.

questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?
options: How to buy a good teapot.
A trip to an old temple in Tainan.
What a teenager learns from tea time with his grandpa.
questions.explain: 全文寫作者每週和爺爺喝茶，聽茶壺的故事，並從中學到人生道理，故選 (D)。(C) 廟只是買茶壺的地點，作者並沒有去旅行。
questions.evidence: I never knew a cup of tea could teach me about life.

vocab.stem: Mia's little sister began to cry, and a ______ ran down her face.
vocab.explain: 哭的時候從臉上流下來的是「眼淚」，故選 tear。taste（味道）、table（桌子）、tea（茶）都不合句意。

vocab.stem: Ben wants to be a ______ in the future because he likes to help students learn.
vocab.explain: 喜歡幫助學生學習，所以想當「老師」，故選 teacher。teenager 是「青少年」，不是一種工作；temple（廟）、teapot（茶壺）也不合。

title: A Tiny Hole
paragraphs: Thursday night. I could not sleep. One of my back teeth hurt badly. My first [[thought|J-1464]] was, "It is nothing. It will stop soon." But by eleven o'clock I had a terrible [[toothache|J-1496]]. I felt [[tired|J-1480]] and [[thirsty|J-1458]], but even cold water made the pain worse.

Friday. Mom took me to the [[dentist|J-0371]] early in the morning. The dentist found a [[tiny|J-1478]] hole in my [[tooth|J-1495]]. "It is small now, but it can grow," she said. She fixed it in [[thirty|J-1460]] minutes. Then she gave me a useful [[tip|J-1479]]: "Hold your [[toothbrush|J-1497]] at an [[angle|J-0056]] and brush for two minutes. Do not [[forget|J-0556]] the backs of your teeth."

Before I left, I asked, "Can I eat [[tonight|J-1492]]?" She laughed and said, "Yes, but only eat soft food like [[tofu|J-1486]] [[today|J-1484]]. You can eat anything [[tomorrow|J-1490]]." Now I brush my teeth carefully every morning and night. A tiny hole can cause big pain!
zh: 星期四晚上。我睡不著。我後排的一顆牙齒痛得很厲害。我的第一個想法是：「沒什麼，很快就不痛了。」但到了十一點，我的牙痛變得非常嚴重。我又累又渴，可是連喝冷水都讓疼痛更加劇烈。
星期五。媽媽一大早就帶我去看牙醫。牙醫在我的牙齒上發現一個很小的洞。「它現在很小，但會變大，」她說。她花了三十分鐘把它補好。接著她給了我一個有用的訣竅：「牙刷要斜一個角度拿，刷滿兩分鐘。別忘了刷牙齒的背面。」
離開前，我問：「我今晚可以吃東西嗎？」她笑著說：「可以，但今天只能吃像豆腐這樣軟的食物。明天就什麼都能吃了。」現在我每天早晚都仔細刷牙。一個小小的洞，也能帶來大大的疼痛！

questions.stem: What did the dentist find?
options: A problem in the writer's throat.
Nothing wrong with the writer's teeth.
A tiny hole in the writer's tooth.
questions.explain: 第二段說牙醫在作者的牙齒上發現一個小洞，故選 (D)。(C) 與文意相反，作者的牙齒確實有問題。
questions.evidence: The dentist found a tiny hole in my tooth.

questions.stem: The word "tip" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to ______.
questions.explain: 牙醫接著說明怎麼拿牙刷、怎麼刷牙，可見 tip 是「訣竅、建議」，故選 (A)。tip 也有「小費」的意思，但這裡是牙醫給病人的建議，不是 (C) 的小禮物。
questions.evidence: Then she gave me a useful tip: "Hold your toothbrush at an angle and brush for two minutes.

questions.stem: What can the writer eat on Friday?
questions.explain: 牙醫說今天（星期五）只能吃像豆腐這樣的軟食物，故選 (C)。(D) 是明天才可以，不是今天。
questions.evidence: She laughed and said, "Yes, but only eat soft food like tofu today.

questions.stem: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: Dentists are always busy on Fridays.
A small tooth problem taught the writer to care for his teeth.
Cold water is good for a toothache.
Tofu is the best food for students.
questions.explain: 作者因小洞牙痛、看牙醫，之後每天早晚認真刷牙，重點是小問題讓他學會照顧牙齒，故選 (B)。(C) 文中說冷水反而讓疼痛更嚴重。
questions.evidence: Now I brush my teeth carefully every morning and night.

vocab.stem: After the long basketball game, Kevin felt very ______ and went to bed early.
vocab.explain: 打完很久的籃球賽後覺得「疲倦」，所以早早上床，故選 tired。tiny（極小的）、total（總計的）、thick（厚的）都不能形容人的感覺。

vocab.stem: The ant is so ______ that I can hardly see it on the floor.
vocab.explain: 螞蟻「極小」，所以幾乎看不到，故選 tiny。tall（高的）、heavy（重的）、wide（寬的）都與「看不見」的語意不符。

title: A Night Without Power
paragraphs: On Monday, a strong [[typhoon|J-1534]] hit Taiwan, so there was no school. Dad [[turned|J-1526]] on the [[TV|J-1528]], and we watched the news together. Outside, the wind was loud, and the rain fell hard. No [[train|J-1509]] was running, and the streets had no [[traffic|J-1508]] at all.

My [[uncle|J-1537]] lives with us, and he is a careful man. He asked me to help him carry the plants [[upstairs|J-1547]] and bring the bikes inside. "A typhoon can cause big [[trouble|J-1517]]," he said. Then he found a box of [[candles|J-0222]]. "These are very [[useful|J-1549]] when the [[power|J-1098]] goes out," he told me. That night, the power really went out [[twice|J-1531]].

We sat around a candle and played a card game. My uncle told us funny [[stories|J-1377]] from his [[university|J-1541]] days. I laughed [[until|J-1542]] my face hurt. The next morning, I [[uploaded|J-1544]] a photo of our candle to my class group. It was not our [[usual|J-1550]] night, but it was a warm one.
zh: 星期一，一個強烈颱風侵襲台灣，所以停課。爸爸打開電視，我們一起看新聞。外面風聲很大，雨下得很猛。火車全部停駛，街上一輛車也沒有。
我叔叔跟我們住在一起，他是個很細心的人。他要我幫他把盆栽搬到樓上，再把腳踏車推進屋裡。「颱風可能會帶來大麻煩，」他說。接著他找出一盒蠟燭。「停電的時候這些很有用，」他告訴我。那天晚上，真的停電了兩次。
我們圍著一根蠟燭坐著玩牌。叔叔跟我們講他大學時代的趣事。我笑到臉都痠了。隔天早上，我把我們那根蠟燭的照片上傳到班級群組。那不是一個平常的夜晚，卻是一個溫暖的夜晚。

questions.stem: Why was there no school on Monday?
options: The power went out at school.
questions.explain: 第一段第一句說強烈颱風侵襲臺灣，所以停課，故選 (B)。(C) 停電發生在家裡、而且是晚上，不是停課的原因。
questions.evidence: On Monday, a strong typhoon hit Taiwan, so there was no school.

questions.stem: In paragraph 2, what does "These" refer to?
questions.explain: 前一句說叔叔找出一盒蠟燭，接著說「這些在停電時很有用」，These 指蠟燭，故選 (C)。(A) 腳踏車在停電時派不上用場。
questions.evidence: Then he found a box of candles.

questions.stem: How many times did the power go out that night?
questions.explain: 第二段最後說那天晚上真的停電了兩次（twice），故選 (D)。(A) once 是一次，與 twice 不同。
questions.evidence: That night, the power really went out twice.

questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?
options: A family spends a typhoon night together and has a good time.
How to fix the power after a typhoon.
Why trains stop running in bad weather.
questions.explain: 全文寫颱風天停課、停電，一家人點蠟燭玩牌聽故事，最後說那是個溫暖的夜晚，故選 (A)。(D) 大學只出現在叔叔講的故事裡，不是重點。
questions.evidence: It was not our usual night, but it was a warm one.

vocab.stem: There is a lot of ______ on this road in the morning, so the buses are often slow.
vocab.explain: 早上這條路上「車流」很多，所以公車常常很慢，a lot of traffic 是「交通繁忙」，故選 traffic。uncle（叔叔）、twice（兩次）、upstairs（在樓上）都不合句意。

vocab.stem: A dictionary is very ______ when you learn a new language.
vocab.explain: 學新語言時字典很「有用」，故選 useful。ugly（醜的）、upper（上面的）、tired（疲倦的）都不能形容字典的功用。

title: A Day at the Waterfalls
paragraphs: Last [[weekend|J-1588]], my class [[visited|J-1559]] a small [[village|J-1557]] in the [[mountains|J-0909]] of Hualien. The [[weather|J-1583]] was sunny and [[warm|J-1572]]. Our teacher told us to [[wear|J-1582]] good shoes, because we had to walk for two hours.

The road was long, and some students began to feel [[weak|J-1581]]. Then we heard a loud sound. It was the [[waterfalls|J-1577]]! There were three of them, and the water fell down from high [[rocks|J-1179]]. We took off our shoes and played in the [[river|J-1176]]. Soon everyone was [[wet|J-1593]], and Ken even fell in! We all laughed, and Lisa took a [[video|J-1556]] of him.

Before we left, an old man from the village gave us a big [[watermelon|J-1578]]. It was sweet and cold. We [[waved|J-1579]] to him from the bus. On the [[way|J-1580]] home, I was tired but happy. I want to go back there on my next [[vacation|J-1552]].
zh: 上個週末，我們班去參觀花蓮山上的一個小村莊。天氣晴朗又溫暖。老師要我們穿好走的鞋子，因為我們得走兩個小時的路。
路很長，有些同學開始覺得沒力氣。接著我們聽到很大的聲音，是瀑布！一共有三道瀑布，水從高高的岩石上落下來。我們脫掉鞋子在河裡玩。很快大家都濕透了，Ken 甚至跌進水裡！我們都笑了，Lisa 還把他拍成影片。
離開前，村裡一位老先生送我們一顆大西瓜，又甜又冰。我們在遊覽車上向他揮手。回家的路上，我很累但很開心。下次放假，我還想再去那裡。

questions.stem: Why did the teacher ask the students to wear good shoes?
options: They had to walk for two hours.
They were going to swim in the sea.
The weather was cold and wet.
They were going to play basketball.
questions.explain: 第一段說老師要大家穿好鞋，因為要走兩個小時的路，故選 (A)。(C) 文中說天氣晴朗溫暖，不是又冷又濕。
questions.evidence: Our teacher told us to wear good shoes, because we had to walk for two hours.

questions.stem: What happened to Ken at the river?
options: He took a video of Lisa.
He felt weak and went back to the bus.
questions.explain: 第二段說大家都濕了，Ken 甚至跌進水裡，故選 (B)。(C) 是 Lisa 拍 Ken 的影片，主客顛倒了。
questions.evidence: Soon everyone was wet, and Ken even fell in!

questions.stem: How did the writer probably feel about the trip?
questions.explain: 作者說回程雖累但很開心，還想下次放假再去，可見他很喜歡這趟旅行，故選 (D)。(C) 雖然 Ken 跌進水裡，但大家都在笑，並不害怕。
questions.evidence: I want to go back there on my next vacation.

questions.stem: What is the best title for the passage?
options: A Fun Class Trip to the Mountains
questions.explain: 全文寫全班到花蓮山上的村莊走路、玩瀑布、吃西瓜的一日班遊，故選 (C)。(B) Ken 跌進水只是其中一個小插曲。
questions.evidence: Last weekend, my class visited a small village in the mountains of Hualien.

vocab.stem: It is cold outside, so you should ______ a sweater.
vocab.explain: 外面很冷，應該「穿」毛衣，故選 wear。wash（洗）、wave（揮手）、wait（等待）都不合句意。

vocab.stem: Amy forgot her umbrella, so her hair was ______ when she got home.
vocab.explain: 忘了帶傘，回家時頭髮是「濕的」，故選 wet。weak（虛弱的）、warm（溫暖的）、west（西方）都不合。

title: The Winner Is...
paragraphs: [[Yesterday|J-1646]] was a big day for our writing club. Every year, the school gives a [[prize|J-1113]] for the best short story, and this time I sent one in. I [[wrote|J-1638]] it in two weeks. I always [[worry|J-1635]] that my English is [[wrong|J-1640]], so I checked every [[word|J-1629]] many times.

My story is about a [[young|J-1648]] [[worker|J-1632]] in a [[bakery|J-0101]]. She works hard every day, but she has a [[wish|J-1619]]: she wants to see the [[world|J-1633]]. Our teacher, Ms. Lin, is a [[writer|J-1639]] too. She read my story and said, "Good job. Now make the ending stronger." So I wrote the ending again.

At the club meeting, Ms. Lin read the name of the [[winner|J-1616]]. It was me! I could not believe it. Everyone clapped, and my best friend Emma shouted, "[[Wonderful|J-1626]]!" Ms. Lin gave me some [[wise|J-1618]] [[advice|J-0021]]: "Do not stop. Keep writing, and you will grow." I have not started my next story [[yet|J-1647]], but I already have an idea.
zh: 昨天是我們寫作社的大日子。學校每年都會頒獎給最好的短篇故事，這次我也投稿了。我花了兩個星期寫完。我總是擔心自己的英文有錯，所以每個字都檢查了很多遍。
我的故事是關於麵包店裡一位年輕的員工。她每天都很努力工作，但她有一個願望：她想去看看這個世界。我們的老師林老師自己也是作家。她讀了我的故事後說：「寫得好。現在把結尾寫得更有力一點。」於是我把結尾重寫了一遍。
在社團聚會上，林老師唸出得獎者的名字。是我！我簡直不敢相信。大家都拍手，我最好的朋友 Emma 大喊：「太棒了！」林老師給了我一個很有智慧的建議：「不要停下來。繼續寫，你就會進步。」我還沒開始寫下一個故事，但我已經有點子了。

questions.stem: What is the writer's story about?
options: A teacher who wants to win a prize.
A young bakery worker who wants to see the world.
A writer who works in a big city.
A club that wins a basketball game.
questions.explain: 第二段說故事是關於麵包店裡一位想看看世界的年輕員工，故選 (B)。(C) 作家指的是林老師，不是故事內容。
questions.evidence: My story is about a young worker in a bakery.

questions.stem: What did Ms. Lin ask the writer to do with the story?
questions.explain: 林老師說「現在把結尾寫得更有力一點」，故選 (C)。(A) 老師並沒有要求縮短故事。
questions.evidence: She read my story and said, "Good job. Now make the ending stronger."

questions.stem: The word "wise" in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to ______.
questions.explain: wise 是「有智慧的、明智的」，與 smart 最接近，故選 (D)。林老師的建議是要作者繼續寫作，並不好笑，所以不是 (A)。
questions.evidence: Ms. Lin gave me some wise advice: "Do not stop.

questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?
options: A student wins a writing prize and wants to keep writing.
How to work in a bakery.
Why English is hard for students.
A teacher who writes many books.
questions.explain: 全文寫作者投稿短篇故事、修改結尾、得獎，最後打算繼續寫，故選 (A)。(C) 作者擔心英文出錯只是一個細節。
questions.evidence: I have not started my next story yet, but I already have an idea.

vocab.stem: Don't ______ about the test. You studied hard, so you will do well.
vocab.explain: 你很用功，所以別「擔心」考試，故選 worry。write（寫）、wish（希望）、work（工作）接 about the test 不合句意。

vocab.stem: Sorry, I took the ______ bus and came to school late.
vocab.explain: 搭「錯」公車所以遲到，故選 wrong。wise（明智的）、young（年輕的）、wonderful（極好的）都無法解釋為什麼遲到。

title: A Winter Day at the Zoo
paragraphs: It was a cold and [[windy|J-1614]] Saturday in [[winter|J-1617]], but my little [[cousin|J-0334]] Leo really wanted to go to the [[zoo|J-1655]]. He is only six, so my aunt asked me to take him. "Staying home is [[zero|J-1654]] fun!" Leo said. I laughed and put on my coat.

At the zoo, Leo ran from one animal to the next. He loved the [[zebra|J-1653]] most. "[[Why|J-1606]] does it have black and [[white|J-1602]] lines?" he asked. I did not know the answer, so we read the sign together. Next, we saw a gray [[wolf|J-1623]]. It looked [[wild|J-1609]] and strong, and Leo held my hand. Then a big bird opened its [[wings|J-1615]]. They were very [[wide|J-1607]]!

At [[noon|J-0964]], we shared a sweet potato and some hot soup. "[[Yummy|J-1652]]!" Leo said. On the bus home, he fell asleep on my arm. I looked out the [[window|J-1613]] and smiled. When I was a kid, my older cousin took me to this zoo, too. Now it is my [[turn|J-1526]]. Someday, Leo will remember this day from his [[youth|J-1651]], just like I remember mine.
zh: 那是個寒冷又風大的冬天星期六，但我的小表弟 Leo 非常想去動物園。他才六歲，所以阿姨請我帶他去。「待在家一點都不好玩！」Leo 說。我笑了笑，穿上外套。
到了動物園，Leo 從一種動物跑到下一種動物。他最喜歡斑馬。「為什麼牠身上有黑白線條？」他問。我不知道答案，所以我們一起看了解說牌。接著我們看到一隻灰狼，牠看起來野性十足又強壯，Leo 緊緊握住我的手。然後一隻大鳥張開了翅膀，好寬啊！
中午，我們一起分著吃一顆烤地瓜和一碗熱湯。「好好吃！」Leo 說。回家的公車上，他靠在我的手臂上睡著了。我望著窗外微笑。我小時候，我的表哥也帶我來過這座動物園。現在輪到我了。總有一天，Leo 也會想起他年少時的這一天，就像我記得我的那一天一樣。

questions.stem: Which animal did Leo like the most?
questions.explain: 第二段說 Leo 最喜歡斑馬，故選 (C)。(A) 看到狼時 Leo 反而有點怕，握住了作者的手。
questions.evidence: He loved the zebra most.

questions.stem: Why did Leo probably hold the writer's hand?
options: The wolf looked wild and a little scary.
questions.explain: 狼看起來野性十足又強壯，Leo 就握住作者的手，可推知他有點害怕，故選 (D)。(C) 他是在回程公車上才睡著。
questions.evidence: It looked wild and strong, and Leo held my hand.

questions.stem: In paragraph 3, what does "Now it is my turn" mean?
options: Now the writer takes a younger cousin to the zoo.
Now the writer wants to see the animals alone.
Now the writer has to cook lunch.
Now the writer must go back to school.
questions.explain: 作者小時候是表哥帶他來動物園，現在換他帶小表弟來，所以「輪到我了」，故選 (A)。(B) 作者是帶著 Leo 一起去，不是一個人。
questions.evidence: When I was a kid, my older cousin took me to this zoo, too.

questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?
options: How to keep warm in winter.
A teenager takes his little cousin to the zoo and shares a happy day.
Why zebras have black and white lines.
The best food to eat at the zoo.
questions.explain: 全文寫作者在冬天帶小表弟逛動物園、吃午餐，並想起自己小時候的回憶，故選 (B)。(C) 斑馬的線條只是 Leo 的一個問題，文中沒有回答。
questions.evidence: Now it is my turn.

vocab.stem: Our team scored ______ points in the first half, but we did better later.
vocab.explain: 上半場得「零」分，後來表現較好，故選 zero。wide（寬的）、yummy（好吃的）、white（白色的）都不能修飾 points。

vocab.stem: This night market sells many ______ snacks, like hot dogs and fried chicken.
vocab.explain: 夜市賣很多「好吃的」點心，故選 yummy。windy（風大的）、wild（野生的）、wide（寬的）都不適合形容食物。

title: My Summer Job at the Night Market
paragraphs: This summer, I helped at my uncle's food stall at the night market [[for the first time|JP-033]]. The stall sells [[lots of|JP-036]] snacks, [[such as|JP-003]] fried chicken and sweet potato balls. I worked there [[from six to eleven|JP-002]] every night. On the first night, I was [[so slow that|JP-007]] a long line of people stood [[in front of|JP-030]] our stall. I [[had to|JP-005]] say sorry again and again.

My uncle told me not to [[worry about|JP-040]] it. He showed me how to [[pick up|JP-027]] the chicken quickly and put it into bags. He also said a good seller must remember the [[price|J-1106]] of every snack. After a few nights, I [[was able to|JP-009]] work much faster. [[More and more|JP-037]] people came to our stall, and the [[smell|J-1309]] of fried chicken was everywhere.

[[At the end of|JP-048]] the summer, I [[found out|JP-019]] that the job taught me [[not only how to cook but also|JP-015]] how to talk with all kinds of people. My uncle smiled and gave me a big bag of [[delicious|J-0370]] chicken to take home.
zh: 今年暑假，我第一次到舅舅在夜市的小吃攤幫忙。攤子賣很多小吃，像是炸雞和地瓜球。我每天晚上從六點工作到十一點。第一天晚上，我動作慢到攤子前面排了一長串人。我只好一再說抱歉。
舅舅叫我不要擔心。他教我怎麼快速夾起雞肉、裝進袋子裡。他還說，好的賣家一定要記得每樣小吃的價錢。過了幾個晚上，我已經能做得快多了。越來越多人來我們的攤子，到處都是炸雞的香味。
暑假結束時，我發現這份工作不只教我怎麼煮東西，也教我怎麼和各式各樣的人說話。舅舅笑著給我一大袋好吃的炸雞帶回家。

questions.stem: When did the writer work at the stall every night?
questions.explain: 第一段說作者每天晚上從六點工作到十一點，故選 (B)。(D) 起始時間對，但結束時間錯。
questions.evidence: I worked there from six to eleven every night.

questions.stem: Why did a long line of people stand in front of the stall on the first night?
options: The snacks were very cheap that night.
The uncle was not at the stall.
There was a free show at the night market.
questions.explain: 第一段說第一天晚上作者動作慢到攤子前排了長長的人龍，可知是因為作者做得太慢，故選 (C)。(B) 文中沒說舅舅不在。
questions.evidence: On the first night, I was so slow that a long line of people stood in front of our stall.

questions.stem: What did the uncle say a good seller must do?
options: Remember the price of every snack.
questions.explain: 第二段說舅舅認為好的賣家一定要記得每樣小吃的價錢，故選 (D)。(B) 微笑待客聽起來合理，但文中沒有提到。
questions.evidence: He also said a good seller must remember the price of every snack.

questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?
options: A student learns a lot from a summer job at a night-market stall.
A student explains how to make fried chicken.
An uncle opens a new restaurant in Taipei.
A family visits many night markets in Taiwan.
questions.explain: 全文寫作者暑假在夜市攤位打工，從手忙腳亂到學會做事與待人，故選 (A)。(B) 炸雞只是攤位賣的東西，文中沒有教做法。
questions.evidence: At the end of the summer, I found out that the job taught me not only how to cook but also how to talk with all kinds of people.

vocab.stem: Don't ______ the rain. I have an extra umbrella for you.
vocab.explain: 我多帶了一把傘，所以叫對方不要「擔心」下雨，worry about 最通順，故選 worry about。look at（看）、pick up（撿起）、come from（來自）都不合句意。

vocab.stem: Kevin used his phone to ______ when the next train leaves.
vocab.explain: 用手機「查出」下一班火車何時開，find out 最適合，故選 find out。arrive at（到達）、be famous for（以⋯⋯聞名）、a piece of（一片）都不合。

title: Our Class Play
paragraphs: Our class was going to act in a short play at the school festival. I [[was interested in|JP-051]] acting, so I tried out for the main role and got it. [[At first|JP-085]], I was very happy. Then I read my part. There were so many lines to remember!

[[First of all|JP-058]], I wrote my lines on cards and read them [[all the time|JP-082]], even on the bus. I [[woke up|JP-076]] early every morning to [[practice|J-1099]]. Some lines were hard, and I wanted to [[give up|JP-060]]. But my friend Amy [[believed in|JP-092]] me. She [[helped me with|JP-062]] my lines after school. We also made the clothes for the play. They [[were made of|JP-087]] old paper bags, but they looked great.

On the day of the play, I [[was worried about|JP-091]] forgetting my lines. I had never acted [[in public|JP-064]] before. Amy said, "Just [[do your best|JP-057]]." [[After a while|JP-081]] on the stage, I felt [[brave|J-0185]], and every line came back to me. When the play ended, the [[crowd|J-0344]] clapped loudly. I was so [[proud|J-1119]] of our class.
zh: 我們班要在校慶上演一齣短劇。我對演戲有興趣，所以去爭取主角，結果選上了。一開始我很開心。後來我讀了自己的部分，要背的台詞好多！
首先，我把台詞寫在卡片上，隨時拿出來讀，連在公車上也讀。我每天早上很早起床練習。有些台詞很難，我曾經想放棄。但我的朋友 Amy 相信我做得到。她放學後幫我練台詞。我們也自己做了戲服。戲服是用舊紙袋做的，但看起來很棒。
演出當天，我很擔心忘詞。我以前從來沒有在大家面前演過戲。Amy 說：「盡力就好。」在台上過了一會兒，我覺得勇敢起來，每句台詞都想起來了。戲演完時，觀眾大聲鼓掌。我真為我們班感到驕傲。

questions.stem: What did the writer do first to remember the lines?
options: The writer asked the teacher to make the lines shorter.
The writer wrote the lines on cards and read them all the time.
The writer listened to the lines on a phone at night.
The writer watched other students act the play.
questions.explain: 第二段說作者首先把台詞寫在卡片上並隨時閱讀，故選 (B)。(C) 用手機聽台詞文中沒有提到。
questions.evidence: First of all, I wrote my lines on cards and read them all the time, even on the bus.

questions.stem: Why did the writer want to give up?
options: Amy did not help the writer.
The writer did not like the role.
The clothes for the play looked bad.
Some of the lines were hard.
questions.explain: 第二段說有些台詞很難，作者想放棄，故選 (D)。(A) 與文意相反，Amy 其實有幫作者練台詞。
questions.evidence: Some lines were hard, and I wanted to give up.

questions.stem: The word "crowd" in paragraph 3 refers to ______.
questions.explain: crowd 是「人群」，戲演完時大聲鼓掌的是看戲的人，故選 (C)。(B) 演戲的同學在台上演出，不是鼓掌的人群。
questions.evidence: When the play ended, the crowd clapped loudly.

questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?
options: A student works hard for a class play and does well with a friend's help.
A student teaches friends how to make clothes.
A class decides not to join the school festival.
A teacher writes a new play for the school.
questions.explain: 全文寫作者為班級戲劇努力背台詞、在朋友鼓勵下成功演出，故選 (A)。(B) 做戲服只是其中一個小細節。
questions.evidence: I was so proud of our class.

vocab.stem: The math problem was very hard, but Leo did not ______. He tried again and finally got the answer.
vocab.explain: 題目很難但 Leo 沒有「放棄」，再試一次後解出答案，故選 give up。show up（出現）、take off（脫下；起飛）、look up（查詢）都不合句意。

vocab.stem: My brother ______ animals, so he wants to be a doctor for dogs and cats.
vocab.explain: 想當獸醫是因為「對動物有興趣」，故選 is interested in。lives on（以⋯⋯為生）、belongs to（屬於）、is made from（由⋯⋯製成）都不合句意。

title: A Morning at the Beach
paragraphs: Last Saturday, our club helped clean a [[beach|J-0120]] near Hualien. We [[got off|JP-140]] the bus at eight and [[waited for|JP-133]] our leader, Ms. Lin. She said, "You [[had better|JP-141]] [[put on|JP-147]] your hats. The sun is strong today." Then she gave each of us a pair of [[gloves|J-0603]] and a big bag.

At first, the beach looked clean. But soon we saw that the sand [[was full of|JP-137]] small pieces of plastic. We also found old shoes and lots of [[bottles|J-0178]]. Ben and I [[kept on|JP-112]] working for two hours. Every time we found something strange, we [[wrote it down|JP-135]] in a notebook. Some people who [[passed by|JP-119]] stopped to thank us.

Before we [[went back|JP-106]] to the bus, Ms. Lin [[took a picture|JP-148]] of us with our forty full bags. On the way home, we [[talked about|JP-127]] how to [[take care of|JP-125]] the ocean in our daily life, such as bringing our own cups. We were tired, but we [[had a good time|JP-110]]. [[In short|JP-111]], it was a morning to remember.
zh: 上星期六，我們社團到花蓮附近幫忙淨灘。我們八點下公車，等待領隊林老師。她說：「你們最好戴上帽子，今天太陽很大。」接著她發給每個人一雙手套和一個大袋子。
一開始，海灘看起來很乾淨。但很快我們就發現沙子裡滿是小塊的塑膠。我們還找到舊鞋子和很多瓶子。Ben 和我持續工作了兩個小時。每次找到奇怪的東西，我們就把它記在筆記本上。有些路過的人停下來向我們道謝。
回到公車上之前，林老師幫我們和四十袋裝滿的垃圾拍了一張照片。回家路上，我們討論在日常生活中可以怎麼愛護海洋，像是自備杯子。我們雖然很累，但玩得很開心。總之，這是一個難忘的早晨。

questions.stem: Why did Ms. Lin ask the students to put on their hats?
options: Their club wanted to take a picture.
The sun was strong that day.
The wind on the beach was cold.
questions.explain: 第一段林老師說今天太陽很大，所以最好戴帽子，故選 (C)。(B) 拍照是最後才發生的事，與戴帽子無關。
questions.evidence: The sun is strong today.

questions.stem: What did the writer and Ben do when they found something strange?
options: They wrote it down in a notebook.
They gave it to the people passing by.
They showed it to Ms. Lin at once.
questions.explain: 第二段說每次找到奇怪的東西，他們就記在筆記本上，故選 (A)。(D) 文中沒有說要馬上拿給林老師看。
questions.evidence: Every time we found something strange, we wrote it down in a notebook.

questions.stem: How did the writer most likely feel at the end of the day?
questions.explain: 第三段說雖然很累但玩得很開心，可知作者又累又開心，故選 (D)。(B) 文中沒有提到生病或難過。
questions.evidence: We were tired, but we had a good time.

questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?
options: How to swim safely at the beach.
A club cleans a beach and learns to care for the ocean.
Why Hualien is famous for its beaches.
A student loses a notebook at the beach.
questions.explain: 全文寫社團到海灘撿垃圾，並討論如何愛護海洋，故選 (B)。(C) 花蓮只是地點，文章沒有介紹它為何出名。
questions.evidence: In short, it was a morning to remember.

vocab.stem: When Mom is at work, I ______ my little brother and make lunch for him.
vocab.explain: 媽媽上班時由我「照顧」弟弟並幫他做午餐，故選 take care of。laugh at（嘲笑）、pass by（路過）、get off（下車）都不合句意。

vocab.stem: It is going to rain this afternoon. You ______ take an umbrella with you.
vocab.explain: 快下雨了，「最好」帶傘，had better 後接原形動詞，故選 had better。are afraid of、are good at 後面不能直接接原形動詞 take；would like 要接 to take。
